competitions.title: ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-2
competitions.summary: 从示例网格推断变换规则，再解出新的网格。
competitions.summaryEN: Infer a transformation from example grids and apply it to a new grid.

guide.zh: 先把一题中的输入与输出并排看，分清哪些颜色、物体和空间关系保持不变。给候选规则换一个训练示例，检查它能否解释全部变化。记录整道题是否完全解对，逐像素平均容易掩盖规则错误。
guide.en: Place the input and output grids side by side and mark which objects, colors and spatial relations survive the transformation. Test a candidate rule against every demonstration before applying it to the unseen grid. Track whole puzzles solved as well as pixel errors.

competitions.title: ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3
competitions.summary: 通过交互探索陌生环境，推断动作与目标之间的关系。
competitions.summaryEN: Explore unfamiliar interactive environments and infer how actions advance the goal.

guide.zh: 与静态网格推理相比，这里还要决定下一步观察什么。挑一个环境，逐步记下动作、画面变化以及当前假设，区分偶然变化和可重复的规律，再用另一条路径验证假设。
guide.en: Here the solver also chooses what to observe. For one environment, record each action, the screen change and your current hypothesis. Replay a different sequence to separate a repeatable interaction from a coincidence.

competitions.title: ARC Prize 2026 - Paper Track
competitions.summary: 用研究论文解释 ARC 推理方法及其证据。
competitions.summaryEN: Document and evaluate a reasoning approach for the ARC Prize research track.

guide.zh: 读论文时先写下作者想解释的推理能力，再检查实验能否把它与记忆样例区分开来。把方法、对照、失败题型分开记录，最后查看官方征稿说明中的评审标准。
guide.en: Start with the reasoning capability the paper claims to measure. Read the controls and failure cases to see whether the experiment separates generalization from memorizing examples. Use the official paper-track criteria to interpret the evidence.

competitions.title: Biohub - Cell Tracking During Development
competitions.summary: 在随时间采集的三维图像中定位并跟踪细胞。
competitions.summaryEN: Locate and track cells across a sequence of three-dimensional images.

guide.zh: 这里既要在单帧找到目标，也要把相邻时刻的检测连成轨迹。挑一段短序列，分别标记漏检、重复检测和轨迹身份交换。这样可以判断改进应集中在定位还是跨帧关联。
guide.en: Separate two tasks while reading a solution: locating each object in one volume and linking detections over time. Inspect a short sequence and label missed detections, duplicates and identity switches to find which stage accounts for an error.

competitions.title: BirdCLEF 2022
competitions.summary: 识别夏威夷声景录音中的鸟鸣。
competitions.summaryEN: Identify bird calls in Hawaiian soundscapes.

guide.zh: 背景声可能比目标鸟鸣更响，一段录音里也可能有多个鸟种。先听同一鸟种在不同背景下的片段，再查看时频图上短促叫声出现的位置。比较不同模型时，保留相同的切片边界与评估录音。
guide.en: A recording can contain several species, and the background may dominate a quiet call. Listen to the same species in different settings and locate the short calls on a spectrogram. Keep segment boundaries and evaluation recordings fixed when comparing detectors.

competitions.title: BirdCLEF 2023
competitions.summary: 识别肯尼亚野外录音中的鸟种。
competitions.summaryEN: Identify bird species in Kenyan field recordings.

guide.zh: 历届训练资料可能重复，同一声音出现在训练和验证两端会让分数看起来过好。先看每个物种有多少独立录音，再用同一划分比较两种模型。结合各物种成绩判断改动是否也帮助了少见鸟种。
guide.en: Recordings recur across collections. If a copy reaches both training and validation, the model can recognize the clip itself. Count independent recordings per species before comparing models on the same split, then inspect rare species separately.

competitions.title: BirdCLEF 2024
competitions.summary: 从连续录音中识别西高止山脉的鸟类。
competitions.summaryEN: Recognize bird species in continuous recordings from the Western Ghats.

guide.zh: 带标签的短录音往往能清楚听见目标鸟，连续声景里则有安静区间、远处鸟鸣和多种背景声。先比较两类音频的时长与能量分布，然后在固定验证折上分别记录常见与稀有鸟种的 AUC，再判断加入无标签声景是否值得。
guide.en: Labeled clips often foreground one bird. A continuous soundscape also contains quiet stretches, distant calls and overlapping sounds. Compare duration and signal energy across the two collections. On a fixed fold, inspect AUC by species before deciding whether unlabeled soundscapes help.

competitions.title: Bristol-Myers Squibb – Molecular Translation
competitions.summary: 从分子结构图预测对应的 InChI 字符串。
competitions.summaryEN: Transcribe a molecular structure image into its InChI string.

guide.zh: 模型接收图像，提交的是字符串。读错一个符号可能引入多个字符编辑。先把错误分成图像识别、字符串生成和候选排序三类，再用编辑距离比较改进，保留原图以便回查。
guide.en: The input is an image and the output is a string. A single misread symbol can require several character edits. Keep the image beside each prediction, label errors from visual recognition, sequence generation or reranking, and compare their edit distances.

competitions.title: Predicting Molecular Properties
competitions.summary: 利用分子结构预测原子对之间的标量耦合常数。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict scalar coupling constants for atom pairs from molecular structures.

guide.zh: 同一个分子里有多个待预测的原子对，它们共享结构背景。用分子而非单行划分本地验证，再按耦合类型分开统计绝对误差，可判断总分的变化主要来自哪一类原子对。
guide.en: Several target pairs can belong to the same molecule and share structural context. Hold out whole molecules in a local experiment. Break absolute errors down by coupling type to see which groups drive a change in the overall score.

competitions.title: Connect X
competitions.summary: 开发在棋盘上实现连续连子的对战策略。
competitions.summaryEN: Build an agent that connects pieces in a line on a game board.

guide.zh: 每步落子同时改变自己的连线机会和对方的威胁。先用少量固定棋局测试能否发现一步获胜和必须防守的位置，再让智能体轮流执先、执后与同一对手对局，分别记录胜率。
guide.en: Each move affects both your winning lines and the opponent’s threats. Start with positions that have a forced win or a mandatory block. Then alternate which agent moves first against a fixed opponent and report results by starting side.

competitions.title: Contradictory, My Dear Watson
competitions.summary: 判断多语言句子对的蕴含、矛盾或中立关系。
competitions.summaryEN: Classify multilingual sentence pairs as entailment, contradiction or neutral.

guide.zh: 输入包含前提与假设，词语相似并不能确定逻辑关系。挑出词汇重合但标签不同的句对，观察否定、数量和指代。按语言查看混淆矩阵，可以发现整体准确率掩盖的弱点。
guide.en: The input is a premise and a hypothesis. Inspect pairs with overlapping vocabulary but different labels, especially those involving negation, quantities or references. Compare confusion matrices by language to find weaknesses hidden by overall accuracy.

competitions.title: Digit Recognizer
competitions.summary: 从 MNIST 图像识别手写数字。
competitions.summaryEN: Classify handwritten MNIST digits from their pixel values.

guide.zh: 每行像素需要按原顺序恢复成图像。先画出几张样本，确认方向和归一化一致，再查看最常互相混淆的两类数字。用同一验证集比较线性基线和卷积模型，保存错分样例。
guide.en: Restore each row of pixels to an image before modeling. Plot examples to verify orientation and scaling, then inspect the pair of digits your baseline confuses most often. Compare a linear classifier and a convolutional model on the same split.

competitions.title: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
competitions.summary: 根据质谱数据推断复杂提取物中小分子的二维化学结构。
competitions.summaryEN: Infer two-dimensional molecular structures from mass spectra of complex extracts.

guide.zh: 这是候选检索和排序问题。先检查正确结构是否进入候选集，再查看它被排到第几位。如果第一步失败，再好的重排模型也无从选中目标。分别记录候选覆盖率和平均精度有助于定位瓶颈。
guide.en: Treat candidate retrieval and ranking as separate stages. First check whether the correct structure enters the candidate set, then inspect its rank. Recording coverage alongside average precision tells you whether to improve retrieval or reranking.

competitions.title: Feedback Prize - English Language Learning
competitions.summary: 给英语学习者的作文预测六项写作能力分数。
competitions.metric: Mean Weighted Columnwise Root Mean Squared Error
competitions.summaryEN: Score English-language learners’ essays across six writing dimensions.

guide.zh: 同一篇作文有六个分数，各维度相关但误差可能不同。保留按作文划分的折外预测，为每个维度分别计算误差，再看加权总分。阅读融合方案时重点检查权重在哪些样本上学到。
guide.en: Each essay has six related scores. Keep out-of-fold predictions grouped by essay, calculate error per dimension, then inspect the weighted aggregate. When reading an ensemble, identify which essays were used to learn its weights.

competitions.title: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition
competitions.summary: 围绕 Gemma 4 开发自主编程智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Build a software-development agent around Gemma 4.

guide.zh: 先选一道可在本地运行测试的编程题，记录初始代码、智能体提出的修改和测试输出。分别统计读题错误、修改错误及运行超时，再在相同预算下比较提示词或工具配置。
guide.en: Choose a programming task with local tests. Save the initial code, proposed patch and test output. Distinguish task misunderstandings, incorrect edits and timeouts before comparing prompts or tool configurations under the same budget.

competitions.title: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Paper Track
competitions.summary: 用研究论文评估面向软件开发的智能体方法。
competitions.summaryEN: Evaluate a software-engineering agent approach in a research paper.

guide.zh: 阅读时先把论文的主张改写成可测量的问题，例如相同预算下通过多少道测试。核对基准、工具权限和停止条件，比较失败案例，最后检查论文赛道要求提交的证据。
guide.en: Turn the paper’s claim into a measurable question, such as tests passed under a fixed budget. Check the benchmark, available tools and stopping criteria. Compare failure cases and refer to the track rules for the evidence required.

competitions.title: Generalist Gaming Agent
competitions.summary: Build an agent that can play unfamiliar games
competitions.summaryEN: Build an agent that can play unfamiliar games

competitions.title: Google Quantum AI - Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation
competitions.summary: 在通过验证的前提下，减少量子应用所需的计算资源。
competitions.summaryEN: Reduce the resource cost of quantum circuits while preserving verifiable behavior.

guide.zh: 先区分两个目标：改写前后是否等价、通过验证后成本降低多少。保存一份基线电路，只替换一处门序列，比较资源计数并运行官方验证器。抽样模拟适合定位问题，接受条件以验证器为准。
guide.en: Separate correctness from cost. Save a baseline circuit, replace one gate sequence, compare resource counts and run the official verifier. Sample simulations help locate errors. Use the verifier’s acceptance criteria when interpreting the reported cost.

competitions.title: Housing Prices Competition for Kaggle Learn Users
competitions.summary: 用住宅属性预测房价，练习 Kaggle Learn 课程中的机器学习方法。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict home prices from property attributes in the Kaggle Learn exercise.

guide.zh: 可先只用面积和房间数训练小模型，把验证误差换算成平均相差多少成交金额。再添加一组分类特征，保持样本划分不变，并统计缺失值出现时的误差。
guide.en: Fit a small baseline using size and room counts. Interpret mean absolute error in sale-price units. Add one group of categorical features on the same split, then inspect errors on properties with missing attributes.

competitions.title: House Prices - Advanced Regression Techniques
competitions.summary: 根据房屋属性预测成交价，练习特征工程与回归。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict sale prices from residential property attributes.

guide.zh: 房价分布右侧往往有少数高价样本。比较原始价格和对数价格建模时，在同一组房屋上按官方指标评估，再把预测还原到金额查看误差。检查地段或价格档是否系统性偏高、偏低。
guide.en: Compare models trained on raw and log prices using the official metric on the same houses. Convert predictions back to currency as a second diagnostic. Break errors down by neighborhood or price band to find systematic over- or underestimation.

competitions.title: Image Matching Challenge 2023
competitions.summary: 从一组不同视角的照片恢复相机位姿。
competitions.summaryEN: Recover camera poses from images taken at different viewpoints.

guide.zh: 两幅图像有相似纹理，并不保证它们看到同一个三维点。先查看有重叠区域的图像对和局部匹配，再观察这些点在多个视角中的几何一致性。把未匹配成功和位姿估计错误分开分析。
guide.en: A similar texture in two views does not guarantee a shared 3D point. Inspect overlapping image pairs and their local matches, then check whether the matches agree across multiple cameras. Separate missing correspondences from pose-estimation errors.

competitions.title: Kaggriculture
competitions.summary: 在农场模拟游戏中开发智能体，与其他玩家竞争收入。
competitions.summaryEN: Build a farming-simulation agent that competes to earn income.

guide.zh: 行动的收益可能要等多个回合才会体现。先固定游戏种子和对手，以一个简单策略作为基线，记录不同阶段的收入和支出。比较策略时同时看最终收入和表现最差的对局。
guide.en: A decision may pay off several turns later. Fix game seeds and opponents, run a simple baseline policy, and track income and expenses by stage. Compare final income alongside the lowest-performing games.

competitions.title: LLM Classification Finetuning
competitions.summary: 根据 Chatbot Arena 对话预测人类对模型回答的偏好。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict human preferences between model responses in Chatbot Arena conversations.

guide.zh: 要输出的是相对偏好。先交换两份回答的顺序，检查预测能否相应交换，并留意平局样本。用对数损失检查概率质量，尤其关注模型很自信却判断错误的对话。
guide.en: Predict a relative preference. Swap the two responses to test whether the prediction swaps appropriately and inspect ties separately. Log loss makes confidently wrong predictions particularly important, so review those conversations directly.

competitions.title: NeurIPS 2024 - Lux AI Season 3
competitions.summary: 在部分可观测的网格游戏中训练对战智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Train an agent to compete in a partially observed grid game.

guide.zh: 当前画面只揭示部分地图，策略需要决定哪些历史观测仍然可信。比较只看当前帧与保留历史的两个基线，用同一组对手和种子测试，并按探索阶段和后期决策回看失误。
guide.en: Only part of the map is visible at each step. Compare a current-frame policy with one that retains past observations. Use identical seeds and opponents, then replay losses to distinguish exploration errors from late-game decisions.

competitions.title: Name That LLM
competitions.summary: 阅读一段生成文本，识别写下它的语言模型。
competitions.summaryEN: Identify the language model that wrote a given passage.

guide.zh: 同一家族的模型可能在词汇和标点上非常相似。按作者模型画混淆矩阵，区分跨家族和同家族错分。比较分类器时按类看召回率，避免发布样本较多的模型主导结论。
guide.en: Related models may have similar vocabulary and punctuation. Build a confusion matrix by author model and separate within-family from across-family errors. Inspect recall for each class alongside balanced accuracy.

competitions.title: NFL Big Data Bowl
competitions.summary: 从球员位置和运动信息预测一次冲球推进距离的概率分布。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict the distribution of rushing yards from player positions and motion.

guide.zh: 目标是每个码数阈值上的累计概率，一次冲球只有一个实际推进距离。先验证提交曲线单调且取值合法，再对照开球方向、阵形和场地边界。相同比赛的回合应放在同一验证组。
guide.en: Predict a cumulative probability for each yardage threshold. Check that each row is monotone and bounded, then inspect play direction, formation and field boundaries. Group plays from the same game when building a validation split.

competitions.title: NFL Big Data Bowl 2027
competitions.summary: 从球员测试的传感器轨迹中找出与 NFL 常规赛表现有关的信号。
competitions.summaryEN: Connect sensor traces from player assessments to regular-season NFL performance.

guide.zh: 先确定传感器序列对应哪位球员和哪次测试，再考虑用速度、变化率或时间窗口概括动作。把同一球员的数据放在同一侧，检查训练时使用的特征在预测常规赛表现时是否已经可见。
guide.en: Map each sensor sequence to its player and assessment before aggregating speed, changes or time windows. Split by player so repeated tests cannot appear on both sides. Check that each feature would be available when forecasting regular-season outcomes.

competitions.title: Natural Language Processing with Disaster Tweets
competitions.summary: 判断推文描述的是否为真实灾害。
competitions.summaryEN: Decide whether a tweet describes an actual disaster.

guide.zh: 包含灾害词汇的推文也可能是在开玩笑或使用比喻。用词袋分类器建立基线，再人工查看误报和漏报各一组。分别记录精确率与召回率，观察改变判定阈值后 F 分数如何变化。
guide.en: Disaster words also appear in jokes and metaphors. Build a bag-of-words baseline, then read a sample of false positives and false negatives. Track precision and recall separately while changing the classification threshold.

competitions.title: Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction
competitions.summary: 根据订单簿和成交记录预测短期波动率。
competitions.summaryEN: Forecast short-term realized volatility from order-book and trade records.

guide.zh: 同一股票在不同时间段有不同的交易活跃度。先按时间窗口整理订单簿和成交统计量，再用较早窗口训练、较晚窗口验证。比较邻居特征时，检查每个邻居在预测时点是否已经可见。
guide.en: Aggregate order-book and trade statistics within each time window. Fit on earlier periods and validate on later ones. If you add features from similar stocks or time windows, check that every neighbor would have been available at prediction time.

competitions.title: Google - Agent Harness on Physical-Engineering's Last Exam
competitions.summary: 构建能解决结构、土木、电气和机械工程题的智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Build an agent to solve structural, civil, electrical and mechanical engineering questions.

guide.zh: 先把题目中的已知量、要求量和单位整理成表，再用少量代表题检查输出格式、单位转换和推理过程。对比两个智能体时固定题集与工具预算，按错误类型统计，避免几道长题左右结论。
guide.en: List the givens, target variables and units for representative questions. Check answer format and dimensional consistency before comparing reasoning approaches. Use the same questions and tool budget, and group errors by type.

competitions.title: Predicting Airline Satisfaction
competitions.summary: 根据乘机体验相关特征预测旅客是否满意。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict airline passenger satisfaction from trip and service attributes.

guide.zh: 先检查评分字段的取值范围，区分缺失和低分。用简单分类器估计满意概率，在同一验证集上比较服务评分与行程特征各自的贡献，再看哪些旅客最容易被排错。
guide.en: Check rating scales and distinguish missing values from low scores. Start with a simple probability model, compare service ratings and trip attributes on the same holdout, and inspect which passengers are ranked incorrectly.

competitions.title: Predicting Credit Card Fraud
competitions.summary: 根据交易特征估计信用卡欺诈风险，并按风险对交易排序。
competitions.summaryEN: Rank transactions by their estimated risk of credit-card fraud.

guide.zh: 欺诈通常是少数类，把全部交易预测为正常也可能得到很高的准确率。先比较正常和欺诈交易的风险分数分布，再检查高风险区间里有多少真阳性。用 AUC 评价整体排序，也要查看接近阈值的错序样本。
guide.en: Fraud is a minority class, so a high accuracy can conceal a poor ranking. Plot scores for both classes and measure how many frauds reach the high-risk tail. Use AUC for ranking and inspect errors near an operational threshold.

competitions.title: Predicting Electric Vehicle Purchases
competitions.summary: 根据表格特征预测电动车购买倾向。
competitions.summaryEN: Rank customers by their likelihood of purchasing an electric vehicle.

guide.zh: 先训练一个简单概率模型，保留每个验证样本的预测。按得分从低到高分组，查看实际购买率是否随之上升。加入交互特征后，用相同样本比较排序变化与 AUC。
guide.en: Keep holdout probabilities from a simple baseline. Group examples by predicted score and check whether observed purchase rates rise across groups. Add interactions one at a time and compare changes in ranking and AUC on the same rows.

competitions.title: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection
competitions.summary: 使用多模态影像检测膝部异常。
competitions.summaryEN: Detect knee abnormalities from multimodal imaging data.

guide.zh: 同一检查可能提供多种视图或模态。先核对影像与标签的对应关系，按患者划分验证，避免同一人出现在两侧。比较单模态与多模态模型的错误类型，并检查缺失模态的样本。
guide.en: An examination may contain multiple views or modalities. Verify image-to-label alignment and group validation by patient. Compare error types for single- and multimodal models and inspect examinations with missing inputs.

competitions.title: Santa 2025 - Christmas Tree Packing Challenge
competitions.summary: 把给定数量的树形图块放入尽可能小的正方形。
competitions.summaryEN: Pack tree-shaped pieces into the smallest enclosing square.

guide.zh: 每个候选布局既要放得紧，也要通过无重叠的可行性检查。选小规模实例画出边界与接触位置，分别记录边长和重叠。比较搜索方法时固定运行时间，并统计多次运行的最好值和中位数。
guide.en: A compact layout still has to be feasible. Draw the boundary and contact points for small instances and report side length separately from overlap. Compare search methods under equal runtime using both best and median outcomes.

competitions.title: Santa 2026 - The Elf Calculator
competitions.summary: 从给定的小数值出发，用尽可能少的算术步骤构造目标整数。
competitions.summaryEN: Construct target integers from small starting values using as few arithmetic steps as possible.

guide.zh: 一个中间结果可能帮助构造多个后续数。先在小目标上记录每一步运算及其输入，重放序列检查合法性，再比较不同构造需要多少步。把无效表达式和有效但过长的序列分开处理。
guide.en: Intermediate results can be reused. For small targets, record each operation and its operands, replay the sequence to verify legality, then compare step counts. Separate invalid constructions from valid sequences that are merely long.

competitions.title: Santander Customer Transaction Prediction
competitions.summary: 在匿名表格特征上预测客户是否会进行交易。
competitions.metric: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve
competitions.summaryEN: Predict whether a customer will transact from anonymized numerical features.

guide.zh: 没有业务字段名时，可以先研究每列的分布、重复值和缺失模式。用同一验证划分比较原始数值与频次编码，明确计算频次时可访问哪些样本，之后再评估特征能否迁移。
guide.en: With anonymized columns, begin with distributions, repeated values and missingness. Compare raw values with frequency encodings on the same fold. State exactly which rows were available when computing counts before interpreting their transferability.

competitions.title: Spaceship Titanic
competitions.summary: 根据飞船乘客信息预测其是否被传送到另一维度。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict whether each fictional passenger was transported to another dimension.

guide.zh: 乘客可能属于同一旅行团，组内属性会相关。比较按行随机划分与按团分组划分的结果，检查舱位、消费和缺失字段。加入团体统计时，把统计量的计算限定在当前可见的信息内。
guide.en: Passengers can travel in groups. Compare a random row split with a group-aware split and inspect cabin, spending and missing-value fields. Compute group statistics only from information available at prediction time.

competitions.title: Squares in Squares
competitions.summary: 把指定数量的单位正方形排入尽可能小的正方形。
competitions.summaryEN: Pack a given number of unit squares inside the smallest possible square.

guide.zh: 平移和旋转会同时改变边界与碰撞约束。先在少量方块上验证几何判定，画出最接近重叠的两块。优化阶段分别记录可行率和最小外框边长，以免用无效布局产生看似更好的结果。
guide.en: Translations and rotations change boundary and collision constraints together. Test geometry checks on small cases and plot the closest pair of squares. Track feasibility and enclosing side length separately so an invalid arrangement cannot appear to improve the result.

competitions.title: Store Sales - Time Series Forecasting
competitions.summary: 使用历史记录预测零售门店的商品销售额。
competitions.summaryEN: Forecast retail sales across stores and product families from historical records.

guide.zh: 样本由日期、门店和商品类别共同标识。用向后滚动的窗口做本地验证，比较上一周同日销量与学习模型。加入滞后特征前，逐列检查其值只来自预测日期之前。
guide.en: Rows are indexed by date, store and product family. Use rolling time splits and compare a same-weekday baseline against a learned model. Check that every lag or rolling statistic uses only dates available at the forecast origin.

competitions.title: The Pokémon Company - PTCG AI Battle Challenge Playground
competitions.summary: 训练能够参与宝可梦卡牌对战的智能体。
competitions.summaryEN: Train an agent to play Pokémon Trading Card Game battles.

guide.zh: 每个回合要在合法动作中选择，单局结果还受抽牌影响。先实现一个能完成整局的简单策略，再固定对手和种子比较不同决策。记录胜率时同时保留关键转折回合，便于解释改进。
guide.en: The policy selects from legal actions, and card draws add variance. Start with a policy that completes a game. Compare decisions against fixed opponents and seeds, and keep pivotal turns alongside win rates to explain differences.

competitions.title: Titanic - Machine Learning from Disaster
competitions.summary: 根据乘客资料预测其在泰坦尼克号事故中的生还情况。
competitions.summaryEN: Predict passenger survival from Titanic passenger records.

guide.zh: 从性别、年龄、舱位等字段建立简单生还概率基线，先检查年龄缺失集中在哪些群体。家庭成员或同票号乘客可能相关，试着按同行群体分组验证，再判断特征是否真的带来可迁移的增益。
guide.en: Start with survival probabilities from sex, age and class. Inspect which groups have missing ages. Family members or passengers sharing a ticket can be related, so try group-aware validation before trusting improvements from group features.

competitions.title: Petals to the Metal - Flower Classification on TPU
competitions.summary: 使用 TPU 训练花卉图像分类模型。
competitions.summaryEN: Classify flower photographs using models trained on a TPU.

guide.zh: 外观相似的花种可能只有局部纹理或花瓣形态不同。固定训练和验证图像，比较输入分辨率与裁剪方式。按类别查看误报和漏报，避免样本较多的花种掩盖宏平均 F 分数的变化。
guide.en: Similar flower species may differ only in local texture or petal shape. Keep the split fixed when comparing crop and resolution choices. Inspect false positives and negatives by species to understand changes in macro F-score.

lessons.title: 只在相近风险档里微调欺诈排序
lessons.summary: 把公开预测分成 40 个风险档。CatBoost 学到的分数先减去所在风险区间的典型水平，再以小权重调整原排序。这样能把精力放在难分先后的交易上。
lessons.takeaway: 固定基础预测，比较调整前后的 AUC 和平均名次移动，同时换一个划分检查稳定性。

steps.title: 重建对照组
steps.body: 作者校验五份输入文件的 SHA-256，先重建固定的对照预测。输入顺序或文件变更会破坏这个对比。
steps.bodyEN: Five input files are checked against SHA-256 digests to reconstruct a fixed baseline. A changed file or row order would invalidate the comparison.

steps.title: 确定训练长度
steps.body: 保留欺诈标签的比例，留出 20% 数据评估 AUC，用早停选出树数，再用全部训练数据重训。
steps.bodyEN: The author stratifies by the fraud label, holds out 20% for AUC evaluation, uses early stopping to choose a tree count and refits on the full training set.

steps.title: 在风险档内调序
steps.body: 把 CatBoost 排名转成 logit，在 40 档中估计中位趋势。残差截断到 ±0.55 后乘以 0.035，加入原分。公布的榜分属于整份提交。
steps.bodyEN: CatBoost ranks are converted to logits. A median trend across 40 bands is subtracted, residuals are clipped to ±0.55 and multiplied by 0.035 before addition to the base score. The published score covers the entire submission.

lessons.originalTitle: S6E11 CatBoost within fraud risk bands
lessons.titleEN: Reordering fraud predictions within similar risk bands
lessons.summaryEN: The author divides baseline predictions into 40 risk bands. CatBoost scores are centered on the typical score in each band, and a small residual adjusts the original ranking. The aim is to resolve near ties.

steps.title: 识别误差来源
steps.body: 这一版本关注同一模型家族内接近的判定。作者在开头链接了基线版本，便于对照新增逻辑。

steps.title: 修正局部概率
steps.body: Sibling residual 模块在融合后的 log 概率上工作。它提取标点及常见词等特征，在同一家族内重分配概率。
steps.bodyEN: The sibling-residual module operates on ensembled log probabilities. Features such as punctuation and frequent words redistribute probability within a family.

steps.title: 核查产物
steps.body: 最后读取验证记录，检查结果非空且列为 id 与 model，再保存散列。它验证文件结构；单独模块的得分收益仍需对照实验。

lessons.titleEN: Identify the model family, then distinguish its closest relatives
lessons.summaryEN: The public notebook refines probabilities among related language models using clues in the text. It preserves the ensemble’s overall estimate for the family while reallocating probability within it.
lessons.takeawayEN: Inspect confusions within the same family. Compare confusion matrices before and after the adjustment to detect regressions.

exercise.zh: 给同一段文本列出修改前后概率最高的三个模型，先把同家族概率求和，再看家族内谁排第一。如果选对家族仍分错具体模型，可抽查标点与常用词；若连家族都错了，则应回查基础分类器。
exercise.en: For one passage, list the top three models before and after correction. Sum probabilities by family first, then inspect the winner within that family. A wrong sibling points you toward the text features. A wrong family points back to the baseline classifier.

lessons.author: Mr.Liang
lessons.title: 基于质谱数据的复杂提取物小分子二维结构识别及排序策略
lessons.summary: 本作品针对 Enveda CASMI 2026 竞赛任务，即从质谱数据中推断复杂提取物里的小分子二维结构，提出了一套集成多个方法的得分与排序管线。难点在于候选分子结构众多，且外部库与训练数据之间存在合成物与天然产物的混杂。作者基于现有公开多模型系统，依次添加邻近网络重排序、片段检查(re-ranker)、天然产物倾向性模型(NPX)等策略，调整外部库覆盖阈值，优化名次和可信度得分，实现了排名提升至 0.505 的高水平效果。整体方法兼顾准确率与合理排名，同时对领导分子（rank=1）特殊优化，保证天生合成物不会占优头名。此方案基于多模型融合、谱相似度网络、先验知识调节及学习型天然产物模型，相互补充，应对难区，展现了质谱小分子结构预测的最新前沿技术。
lessons.summaryEN: This work addresses the Enveda CASMI 2026 challenge task of inferring 2D chemical structures of small molecules in complex extracts from mass spectra. The key difficulties include a large candidate structure space and a mixture of synthetic and natural product entries in external and training libraries. The authors build upon existing public multi-model pipelines and progressively incorporate neighbor-network re-ranking, fragment-based re-rankers, and a learned natural-product likeness model (NPX), adjusting external library overlay thresholds to improve ranking accuracy and confidence. Their integrated strategy achieves a top score of 0.505. The overall approach balances precision and ranking robustness by special treatment of lead candidates (rank 1) to prevent synthetic compounds from dominating. The method leverages model ensembles, spectral similarity networks, prior knowledge adjustments, and learned naturalness classifiers, effectively addressing challenge intricacies and demonstrating cutting-edge mass spectral small molecule structure identification techniques.
lessons.takeaway:
1. 通过多层次重排序（邻居网络、片段重排等）提升候选分子的排名质量。
2. 利用天然产物模型（NPX）区分天然与合成结构，防止合成物首位误排。
3. 采用外部库叠加策略并调节阈值，有效利用公共与私有谱图库提高准确率。
4. 配套工程实现及提交策略严谨，确保结果可复现与提交合规。
5. 方法开源且集成多作者优秀成果，有助于进一步研究和改进。
lessons.takeawayEN:
1. Multi-stage re-ranking (neighbor networks, fragment re-rankers) effectively improves candidate ranking quality.
2. Leveraging a natural product likeness model (NPX) distinguishes natural from synthetic structures, avoiding synthetic compounds dominating top ranks.
3. External library overlay with tunable thresholds effectively leverages public and private spectral databases for accuracy gains.
4. Careful engineering and submission protocol ensures reproducibility and valid competition entries.
5. The method integrates multiple state-of-the-art contributions, promoting further research and method development.

steps.title: 输入与环境配置
steps.body: 输入包括质谱峰数据、小分子候选结构及多个外部公共库（如 enveda-180、COCONUT、LOTUS 等）。环境基于 Kaggle 平台，配置固定的颜色、字体及绘图参数，确保结果可视化一致性。加载必要的 Python 包及辅助函数，保证代码运行稳定。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs include mass spectral peak data, candidate small molecule structures, and several external public libraries (e.g., enveda-180, COCONUT, LOTUS). The environment is set up on Kaggle with fixed colors, fonts, and plotting styles for consistent visualization. Necessary Python packages and helper functions are loaded to guarantee stable code execution.

steps.title: 公共和私有模型融合，并替换长训模型
steps.titleEN: Integration of Public and Private Models with Replacement of Long-Trained Model
steps.body: 管线首先调用公开的基础版本模型，随后检测并替换为作者自有私有模型（更长训练时间，更佳表现），通过复制权重和配置文件完成。确保使用的 神经得分器 是最优训练版本，经测试和校验无异常，提升整体预测能力。
steps.bodyEN: The pipeline first invokes the public baseline model, then identifies and replaces it with the authors’ private long-trained model (superior performance) by copying weights and configurations. This ensures the neural scorer used is the best-trained version, tested and verified without errors, improving overall prediction quality.

steps.title: 邻居网络重排序
steps.body:
构建光谱相似邻居网络：若两分子光谱具有相同加合物且修改版余弦相似度≥0.6且匹配峰≥6，则视为邻居。来自邻居的前5名候选贡献证据，按1/排名权重归一化。候选得分为余弦四次方加权邻居证据与分子指纹（Morgan指纹，半径2，2048位）相似度乘积和。
通过统计值z分数结合原排名负对数与网络得分再排序。该方法加入已知结构节点和基于前体差值的边权调节，并执行两轮传播步骤。运行时受内存和时间限制，错误时保留输入以便后续调试。
此步骤提升列表整体排名合理性，特别是3-25名位次调整，1名位一般保持不变。
steps.bodyEN:
Builds a neighbor network over spectra: two molecules are neighbors if they share the same adduct and have modified cosine similarity ≥0.6 with at least 6 matched peaks. Top 5 candidates from neighbors contribute evidence weighted by 1/rank and normalized. Candidate score is a sum of cosine^4 multiplied by weighted Tanimoto similarity between candidate and evidence based on Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits).
The final list is re-sorted by combined z-scores of -log(rank) plus network score with specific weights. The method includes known structure nodes and edge weight reductions for implausible precursor mass differences; applies two propagation steps. Runs with batch memory and time budget guards; on failures input is preserved. This mainly reorders ranks 3–25, leaving rank 1 mostly stable.

steps.title: 天然产物候选重排序（NPX）
steps.body:
针对主链中迷惑的合成物，作者设计了 NPX 模型，基于无立体信息的 Morgan 计数指纹、Fsp3、环数量、杂原子及卤素等特征学习天然产物倾向性。该模型在 held-out 分子上性能优秀（AUC≥0.9），对250个天然产物样本预测概率中位数≥0.6。
对于排名2-25的候选，按得分= -1.5·ln(rank)+0.35·clip(logit p_np, -4,4)重新稳定排序；对于排名1，若它概率极低(<0.02)且无天然产物表支持，则从2-5名中选概率>0.6的天然产物置换前位。
该步骤放在候选库一致性(UNIQ)和合成物降权(E180X)之后，前后顺序严格，若NPX未达门槛则跳过不改。
steps.bodyEN:
To distinguish synthetic compounds from confusing leads, the authors devised NPX, a learned natural product likeness model based on stereochemistry-free Morgan count fingerprints, Fsp3, ring count, heteroatoms, and halogens. The model performs well on held-out molecules (AUC≥0.9) and predicts a median natural product probability ≥0.6 on 250 test natural product examples.
For candidates ranked 2–25, scores are computed as -1.5 * ln(rank) + 0.35 * clipped logit of p_np, and sorted stably. For rank 1, if the candidate shows very low p_np (<0.02) and lacks natural product database presence, it can be replaced by a rank 2–5 candidate with p_np > 0.6. This NPX step is applied after uniqueness enforcement (UNIQ) and synthetic demotion (E180X), and it is gated by model quality thresholds to ensure fail-closed behavior.

lessons.author: star
lessons.title: NTL 720 Sibling Odds 方法解析
lessons.summary: 任务是在生成文本分类竞赛中，通过集成多个基于不同语言模型的子模型预测结果，实现更准确地识别文本属于哪种语言模型。主要难点是测试集很大且资源有限，只有部分文本能被较慢但精准的模型处理，且某些模型家族间区分难度较大。方法动机是融合风格特征、生成模型评分和统计模型等多种视角，通过多阶段分段推理和样本选择，结合变体筛选决策规则，提升分类性能。
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to classify generated texts in a competition by identifying which language model produced them. The main challenge includes large test data with limited budget allowing only partial scoring by slower but more accurate models, and fine distinctions within model families. The method motivates integrating multiple perspectives such as stylistic features, generation model likelihoods, and statistical models in a multi-stage segmented inference pipeline, combined with variant filtering decision rules, to improve classification accuracy.
lessons.takeaway: 本方法通过设计复杂的多阶段推理流水线，实现了对大规模测试样本的高效筛选和多模型融合，尤重视模型家族内的‘兄弟模型’之间判断，通过调整概率增益和样式投票机制来修正决策，提升了细粒度分类结果的准确性。这对资源有限环境下的多分类任务尤其有借鉴意义。
lessons.takeawayEN: This approach uses a complex multi-stage inference pipeline to efficiently select and ensemble predictions on large test sets, emphasizing judgments among sibling models within the same family by adjusting likelihood gains and style votes to refine decisions. It significantly improves fine-grained classification accuracy and serves as a valuable reference for multi-class tasks under resource constraints.

steps.title: 输入与初步模型元数据准备
steps.titleEN: Input and Initial Model Metadata Preparation
steps.body: 读取测试文本数据，确保文本列完整且无缺失。加载众多基模型和相关权重，包括分布在多个目录的模型快照、标记器和辅助数据。此步骤保证后续多模型评估的基础数据准备完整且一致。
steps.bodyEN: Load the test text data ensuring the targeted text column is complete and non-null. Load numerous base models and relevant weights from various mounted directories and snapshots, including tokenizers and auxiliary files. This step ensures the foundational data for subsequent multi-model evaluation is complete and consistent.

steps.title: 两阶段分批GPU推理与特征提取
steps.titleEN: Two-stage Pipelined GPU Inference and Feature Extraction
steps.body: 利用设计好的调度器(z像 pipe.py)将测试文本分成若干批次，在两个GPU上并行载入和推理。先运行大型模型（如Qwen3-8B）的隐藏状态提取，再进行主干模型推理。特殊设计的推理模块（例如 gsq_infer.py 和 gsq_infer_model.py）确保推理效率和内存利用最大化。推理得到文本级别的特征向量和得分，用作后续融合的输入。
steps.bodyEN: Use a customized scheduler (e.g., pipe.py) to split test texts into batches, performing parallel loading and inference on two GPUs. Large models like Qwen3-8B produce hidden states first, followed by core model inference. Specialized inference modules (gsq_infer.py and gsq_infer_model.py) ensure maximal inference efficiency and memory utilization. The resulting text-level feature vectors and scores serve as inputs to subsequent ensemble steps.

steps.title: 核心投票与风格特征结合预测
steps.titleEN: Core Voting and Integration of Style Features in Prediction
steps.body: 采用预训练的支持向量机池（SVC, TFIDF等）结合对文本不同视角转换的统计视图，产生多个投票。虽然部分投票权重设置为0用于测试，整体通过对风格和统计特征的捕获，辅助判别模型族。主干权重融合了各种风格gram和文本特征来源的加权结果，形成强集成预测得分。
steps.bodyEN: Use a pretrained pool of support vector classifiers (SVC, TFIDF, etc.) over different views of text (shape and function words) to produce multiple votes. Some votes are weighted zero in the blend for testing but still used for early error detection. Overall, combining stylistic and statistical features aids family-level discrimination. Core weights blend multiple stylegram and textual feature sources into a strong ensemble prediction score.

steps.title: 兄弟模型间的后验决策规则应用
steps.titleEN: Application of Posterior Decision Rules Among Sibling Models
steps.body: 针对同一模型家族中的‘兄弟模型’，通过计算它们在执行系列推理和概率修正后的对数概率差异，设计特定阈值规则（log(2)限制）判定是否转换预测类别。使用fable模型的得分增益作为调整依据，防止对‘claude-fable-5’的误判。结合风格投票的顶部候选，确保后一致性，提升家族内模型细节区分准确率。
steps.bodyEN: For sibling models within the same family, compute log-probability differences after staged inference and likelihood adjustments, applying threshold rules (e.g., log(2)) to decide whether to switch predictions. Use score gains for the ‘claude-fable-5’ model as a safeguard against misclassification. Incorporate style vote top candidates to ensure consensus, improving fine-grained differentiation within the model family.

steps.title: 分级测试样本调度与部分覆盖机制
steps.titleEN: Hierarchical Test Sample Scheduling and Partial Coverage Mechanism
steps.body: 由于资源约束，大模型无法全量评分测试集。通过对比glm和glm-flash概率，预选排名靠前的文本进行重点计算。使用多阶段流水线(run_pipeline.py和v1_stage.py)，每模型设定硬时间预算，若超时则优先保持已完成部分的预测并调整权重。该策略保证了资源有效利用和评分覆盖，提升整体分类效果。
steps.bodyEN: Due to resource constraints, large models cannot process the entire test set. By comparing probabilities between glm and glm-flash models, the top-ranked texts are selectively re-scored. Utilizing multi-stage pipelines (run_pipeline.py and v1_stage.py), each model has a hard time budget; if exceeded, partial results are retained and weights adjusted accordingly. This strategy ensures resource efficiency and coverage, improving overall classification performance.

lessons.author: Mugundhan Y
lessons.title: 用同族似然概率差修正集成投票：名称分类竞赛中的选择性重打分
lessons.summary: 任务是对一段生成文本判断其来自 18 个候选语言模型中的哪一个，评价指标为 Balanced Accuracy。作者的整套流程由多个读取器（风格、语法、编码器、LoRA 等）加权融合得到基础预测，再选择性抽取一部分测试文本，用 GLM 系列模型的似然进行重打分。但 GLM 似然阶段受时间预算限制，只能读取测试集的一部分，因此难点在于“读哪些行、如何用有限预算修正最弱的类”。作者观察到 claude-fable-5、glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash 三类召回明显偏低，于是在预算不变的情况下改变排队顺序，并加入同族（sibling）决策规则，只把高置信、经似然与风格双重支持的少数行改判。
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to identify which of 18 candidate language models produced a passage, scored by Balanced Accuracy. The author's pipeline blends several readers (stylometry, n-gram style, encoders, LoRA heads) into a base prediction, then selectively re-scores a subset of test rows with GLM likelihood. Because the likelihood stage can only cover part of the test set within its time budget, the difficulty is choosing which rows to read and how to use that limited budget on the weakest classes. The author notes that claude-fable-5, glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash have low recall, so the budget's ranking is reordered and sibling decision rules flip only a few high-confidence rows supported by both likelihood and style heads.
lessons.takeaway: 在有限推理预算下，改变“读哪些行”的排序和加入严格的门控规则，比扩大预算更能提升弱类召回。
lessons.takeawayEN: Under a fixed inference budget, reordering which rows get read plus strict gating rules can improve weak-class recall more than enlarging the budget.

steps.title: 用分组交叉验证定位弱类
steps.titleEN: Locate weak classes via grouped cross-validation
steps.body: 作者在六个已发布读取器上按 prompt 分组做 out-of-fold 评估，发现 claude-fable-5、glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash 的召回分别只有 0.248、0.300、0.320，而 18 类平均为 0.550。这一诊断决定了后续只能在少数类上做文章，而不是全面重打分。
steps.bodyEN: The author runs out-of-fold evaluation of the six shipped readers with prompt-grouped folds and finds that claude-fable-5, glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash recall only 0.248, 0.300 and 0.320 against a mean of 0.550 over all eighteen classes. This diagnosis justifies targeting a few classes rather than re-scoring everything.

steps.title: 在预算内重排待读行的优先级
steps.titleEN: Reorder rows within the same budget
steps.body: GLM 似然阶段在时间预算内只能读取部分测试文本。作者保持预算不变，只在排序分数上加入 0.35 * min(fable_mass, mass)，使集成已经偏向 Fable 的段落最多提前 1.35 倍。输入是基础融合概率，操作是改排序，目的是把有限读取名额优先给最可能被修正的类。
steps.bodyEN: The GLM likelihood stage can only read part of the test set within its budget. The author keeps the budget fixed and adds 0.35 * min(fable_mass, mass) to the ranking score, pushing passages the blend already leans Fable on up by at most 1.35x. The input is the blended mass, the operation is re-ranking, and the goal is to spend limited reads on the rows most likely to need correction.

steps.title: 用似然概率差门控改判
steps.body: fable_return 规则比较重打分前后 Fable 相对 GLM 两类的边际：只有基础预测原本落在 GLM、重打分后转向 Fable、边际提升至少 0.30 且最终边际至少 0.25 时才改判。这避免似然噪声单独驱动标签，但阈值是对训练数据设定的经验值。
steps.bodyEN: The fable_return rule compares Fable's margin over the two GLM classes before and after re-scoring: a flip requires the base prediction to be a GLM class, the post-scoring argmax to be Fable, a margin gain of at least 0.30, and a final margin of at least 0.25. This prevents likelihood noise from driving labels alone, though the thresholds are empirical values fit on training data.

steps.title: 要求似然赢家与风格头同族一致
steps.titleEN: Require sibling agreement with the style head
steps.body: sibling_agreement 进一步约束：似然改判后的赢家必须是风格头的前两名之一，似然改判前的赢家与它同族，族属于 claude/gpt/gemini，且风格头前两名概率比不超过 log 2，同时风格头的赢家也指向它。输入是原预测、似然后预测与风格分数，操作是多重条件合取，目的是只接受高置信的少数改判，局限是规则高度手工化且依赖阈值。
steps.bodyEN: sibling_agreement further requires the likelihood winner to be the style head's runner-up, the pre-flip winner to be in the same family, the family to be one of claude/gpt/gemini, the top-two style scores to be within log 2, and the style winner to point at the same label. Inputs are the original prediction, post-likelihood prediction and style scores; the operation is a conjunction of conditions to accept only a few high-confidence flips; the limitation is that the rules are heavily hand-crafted and threshold-dependent.

steps.title: 提高部分覆盖并保持失败可回退
steps.titleEN: Price partial coverage and keep a fallback
steps.body: 作者基于训练 OOF 估计部分覆盖的收益（15% 文本 +0.030，20% +0.0315，全覆盖 +0.029），说明饱和早于全覆盖。运行阶段设置最小时长/最少文本阈值，预算不够就保留原提交，读取过程与计算重叠。这解释了为何“少读但读对”比全读更划算，但收益数字来自训练集估计，不是提交端保证。
steps.bodyEN: The author estimates the gain of partial coverage on training OOF (15% of texts +0.030, 20% +0.0315, full coverage +0.029), showing saturation before full coverage. The run stage sets minimum-time and minimum-text thresholds and keeps the original submission if budgets fall short, overlapping reads with compute. This explains why reading fewer but better-chosen rows can pay off, though the gain figures are training estimates, not submission guarantees.

lessons.title: 借相似股票预测波动率
lessons.author: nyanp
lessons.summary: 单只股票的一段历史太短。冠军为股票和时段寻找相似样本，再把邻居的统计特征提供给模型。
lessons.takeaway: 在时间切分固定的条件下，为一个基础特征加上邻居均值，比较各折误差。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 作者先重建匿名时段的先后顺序，再使用 4 折时间验证，每折留出约 10% 的数据做验证。
steps.bodyEN: The authors recovered chronological order from anonymous time IDs, then used four temporal folds with about 10% held out in each.

steps.title: 特征工程
steps.body: 从已有统计量构造距离，找到相似股票或相似时段，再聚合邻居特征。这让模型同时看到局部和跨样本的信息。
steps.bodyEN: They defined distances using existing statistics, found similar stocks or periods and aggregated neighbors’ features. The resulting inputs carry both local and cross-sample information.

steps.title: 迁移与复现
steps.body: 原文讨论了竞赛与实际预测的时间信息差异。复现时在每个验证切点限制可访问的邻居，避免提前看到未来。
steps.bodyEN: The writeup discusses differences between competition and real forecasting. At each validation cutoff restrict neighbors to samples that would already be observable.

lessons.titleEN: Borrow information from similar stocks to predict volatility
lessons.summaryEN: A short history for one stock contains little context. The winners found similar stocks and time windows and provided aggregated statistics from those neighbors to the model.
lessons.takeawayEN: On a fixed time split, add a neighbor mean for one baseline feature and compare error fold by fold.

exercise.zh: 从一个时间窗出发，列出选中的近邻、距离和各自的波动统计量。检查近邻是否都在切点之前可用，再比较不加近邻、简单平均和按距离加权三组误差。这样能分清改进来自额外信息还是提前使用了未来数据。
exercise.en: For one time window, list the chosen neighbors, distances and volatility statistics. Verify availability at the cutoff, then compare no neighbors, an unweighted mean and a distance-weighted mean. This separates useful context from accidental access to future data.

lessons.title: 先清理重复录音，再比较鸟声模型
lessons.summary: 作者检查训练录音是否重复，并从历届数据中筛选当年的目标鸟种。模型对照建立在经过清理的数据上。
lessons.takeaway: 先统计各鸟种的样本数，并检查重复录音是否落入不同折。
lessons.author: Volodymyr

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 作者结合时长、上传者与主要鸟种标签筛查重复录音，并手动移除部分重复项。
steps.bodyEN: Duration, uploader and primary species labels were used to screen for duplicates. The author removed a subset manually.

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 作者用五折分层交叉验证评估模型，并围绕比赛采用的 cmAP 指标比较实验。
steps.bodyEN: Models were evaluated with five-fold stratified cross-validation and compared against the competition’s cmAP metric.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 把注意力声音事件检测的预测与各时刻的最大预测组合。原文将该调整的增益描述为较小。
steps.bodyEN: Attention-based sound-event predictions were combined with the maximum prediction over time. The author describes the gain from this adjustment as small.

lessons.titleEN: Clean duplicate recordings before comparing bird-call models
lessons.summaryEN: The author looked for repeated training audio and selected recordings of the target species from earlier editions. Models were then compared on the cleaned collection.
lessons.takeawayEN: Count examples by species and check whether duplicate recordings span validation folds.

exercise.zh: 挑出时长和鸟种相同的两份录音，听取片段确认是否真重复。以录音为单位固定折号，保存清理前后的每类验证分数。再打开推理融合，观察分数变化是否仍出现在同一批鸟种上。
exercise.en: Listen to two clips with the same duration and species before calling them duplicates. Assign folds at recording level and save per-species scores before and after cleaning. Then enable inference blending and inspect whether the same species benefit.

lessons.title: 从无标签声景里学鸟鸣
lessons.author: Team Kefir
lessons.summary: 比赛给了带鸟种标签的短录音，也给了没有标签的野外声景。冠军把两者放进同一套训练流程，让模型接触接近测试环境的背景声。
lessons.takeaway: 先固定一个验证折，比较只用标注录音和加入声景伪标签后的变化。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 不同折的信号强度分布不同。团队比较标准差、能量等统计量，检查为什么某一折表现特别好。

exercise.zh: 把一段声景的时间轴与模型输出对齐，选一个高置信鸟鸣段和一个背景噪声段听一遍。伪标签来自模型本身，可能把噪声也当成鸟。固定训练轮数和验证录音，只改变是否加入伪标签；同时检查安静段误报与各物种 AUC。
exercise.en: Align a soundscape with the model’s time-indexed predictions. Listen to one confident call and one background segment. Pseudo-labels come from a model that can mistake noise for a bird. Hold training epochs and validation recordings fixed, toggle pseudo-labels, and track quiet-segment false positives alongside per-species AUC.

lessons.author: Soheil Ayati
lessons.title: 第二名方案—基于时序三维检测与图结构跟踪的细胞定位与追踪
lessons.summary: 本方案针对在三维显微镜时序图像中定位和跟踪细胞的任务。关键难点在于细胞信号微弱且稀疏，注释不完整，以及跨帧时序信息的有效利用。作者提出结合多帧时序上下文的3D U-Net检测器，输出细胞中心、位置偏移和运动估计，并基于图结构进行候选细胞选择、时序链接和分裂判定。同时，采用合成弱信号细胞增强训练，保留弱探测候选直到通过轨迹连贯性判断其有效性。在后处理阶段利用未用候选恢复遗漏轨迹，且无需重新运行检测器，有效提升检测与跟踪性能。实验表明该管线在私有排行榜取得0.970分，具备稳定的跨嵌合体适应能力。
lessons.takeaway: 关键在于结合时序上下文的稳定三维检测，同时设计图结构追踪以充分利用运动与链接信息。训练中加入合成弱细胞以增强模型对低信号单元的识别能力。重要创新是推迟丢弃弱探测结果，通过轨迹连贯性判断其有效性并进行恢复，无需重新检测器，提升检测召回和整体分数。实验证明，仅在特定采集条件下使用此恢复策略效果最佳，且扩展检测或修复操作需谨慎以免引入误差。

steps.title: 输入与预处理
steps.body: 输入为64×256×256三维显微镜图像序列。首先对每帧图像进行强度归一化，并在空间维度上进行1×4×4的块平均下采样，令输入形状变为64×64×64，满足体素的各向同性（voxel spacing均匀）。利用原始高分辨率图像保留后续验证与精修所需信息。
steps.bodyEN: The input consists of 64×256×256 3D microscopy volume sequences. Each frame undergoes intensity normalization and then downsampling via 1×4×4 voxel block averaging in Z×Y×X order, resulting in isotropic voxel size and an input shape of 64×64×64. Original high-resolution images are retained for later verification and refinement.

steps.title: 基于多帧时序上下文的三维检测
steps.body: 采用残差3D U-Net网络，以相邻三帧（t−1, t, t+1）作为输入通道，形状为3×64×64×64。模型预测细胞中心热图、亚体素级位置偏移、上一帧运动向量及其不确定度，以及图像描述符用于时间链接。辅助检测器使用更多帧的时序信息或其他模型赋能探测多样性和鲁棒性。
steps.bodyEN: A residual 3D U-Net takes three consecutive frames (t−1, t, t+1) as input channels (shape 3×64×64×64). The model outputs cell center heatmaps, sub-voxel spatial offsets, backward motion vectors with uncertainties, and image descriptors to assist temporal linking. Auxiliary detectors employ more frames or alternative models to enhance detection diversity and robustness.

steps.title: 合成弱细胞增强及监督设计
steps.titleEN: Synthetic Faint Cell Augmentation and Supervision Design
steps.body: 针对稀疏标注及弱信号细胞，采用合成数据增强，将真实标注的细胞轨迹提取后进行信号衰减与模糊处理，插入训练影像的不同区域以形成弱细胞样本，且保持数据分组一致。损失函数设计排除未知区域，分开归一化细胞和背景损失，降低伪负样本影响，提升弱细胞识别能力。
steps.bodyEN: To handle sparse annotations and faint cells, synthetic augmentation extracts short isolated cell tracks, dims and blurs them along depth, and blends them into other regions within the same movie, creating weak cell samples while preserving training splits. Loss functions exclude unknown regions and normalize cell and background losses separately to reduce false negatives and enhance faint cell detection.
steps.reference: ### 3.1. Sparse supervision and synthetic faint cells

steps.title: 图结构跟踪及细胞分裂识别
steps.body: 跟踪模块先通过LightGBM模型估计每帧的细胞数，并根据检测置信度及空间约束选择候选细胞，防止重复。利用预测的运动向量提出后继候选，并通过学习链接评分类别特征（距离、运动一致性等）解析前后帧关联。分裂判别器基于几何、外观和时序上下文评估父细胞与两个子细胞，辅助构建合理细胞分裂轨迹。辅助手段包括不同模型生成的候选补充和链接多模型共识，进一步修复图结构。
steps.bodyEN: The tracking module uses LightGBM to estimate the number of cells per frame and selects candidates balancing detection confidence and spatial distinctness, suppressing duplicates. Predicted backward motion guides candidate predecessor selection, with learned scorers evaluating link features such as distance and motion consistency to resolve temporal associations. A division scorer evaluates candidate parent-daughter triplets based on geometry, appearance, and temporal context. Auxiliary models provide missing path candidates and consensus on links and divisions to refine the graph.
steps.reference: ## 4. From candidates to tracks and divisions

steps.title: 基于未用检测的细胞轨迹恢复与边界清理
steps.titleEN: Recovery of Faint Tracks from Unused Detections and Border Cleanup
steps.body: 检测器输出细胞候选多于跟踪保留。V533方案针对采集组acq_01限制下游，复查未用但排位较高且距离现有轨迹较远超过4.5μm的候选，构建至少连续九帧的移动路径（位置变动≤5μm），并基于原始影像中心与背景对比度阈值（≥0.1）确认有效。恢复路径要求与现有轨迹近邻（≤8μm），可附着至轨迹端点扩展或作为新轨迹独立存在。该过程无需重新运行检测器，无新增标注，无新训练。另有对x/y边界1.5像素内预测及其链路的清理以减少边界伪影。
steps.bodyEN: The detector outputs more candidates than the tracker retains. V533 revisits unused, high-ranked candidates more than 4.5 μm from existing predictions (restricted to acquisition group acq_01), links them into persistent paths spanning nine or more consecutive frames with position shifts ≤5 μm per frame, and verifies path validity by median center-to-background contrast ≥0.1 on original images. Candidate paths must be within 8 μm proximity of existing tracks to propose attachments or remain separate if unattached. This recovery does not rerun the detector, access annotations, or retrain models. Additionally, predictions within 1.5 pixels near the x/y frame boundary are removed to reduce boundary artifacts.
steps.reference: ## 5. Recovering faint tracks without another detector pass

llmReview.reason: 该方案包含可复用的具体方法：3D U-Net 结合时序上下文检测、合成暗淡细胞增广、LightGBM 候选选择与图追踪/分裂评分、基于未用候选的弱轨迹恢复及图像证据校验、按图像条件聚类的分组验证与消融。读者可追踪检测、追踪、恢复和验证等决策链，符合可解释步骤要求。

lessons.titleEN: 2nd Place Solution: Temporal 3D Detection and Graph-Based Cell Tracking
lessons.summaryEN: This solution addresses the task of locating and tracking cells in temporal 3D microscopy images. The main challenges include weak and sparse cell signals, incomplete annotations, and effective utilization of temporal information across frames. The author uses a multi-frame 3D U-Net detector to estimate cell centers, position offsets, and motion, followed by graph-based candidate selection, temporal linking, and division scoring. Synthetic faint cells are augmented during training. Weak detection evidence is preserved until validated through trajectory coherence. A late recovery step revisits unused candidates without rerunning detection to restore missing tracks. Experiments show the pipeline achieves 0.970 on the private leaderboard with robustness across embryo variations.
lessons.takeawayEN: The key lies in robust temporal 3D detection combined with graph-based tracking that leverages motion and linking cues. Augmenting training with synthetic faint cells improves detection of low-signal units. A critical innovation is delaying discarding weak detections and validating them through trajectory coherence to recover missed tracks without rerunning the detector, improving recall and overall score. This recovery strategy works best under specific acquisition conditions. Careful balance is necessary when extending detection or repair steps to avoid introducing errors.

exercise.zh:
1. 尝试在单一3D U-Net模型中引入相邻多帧输出来提升检测准确性；
2. 实施合成数据增强，将真实细胞轨迹提取后进行衰减与模糊处理，插入训练样本，以提升模型对弱信号细胞的识别能力；
3. 基于检测器输出的候选点构建时序图，设计评分函数进行轨迹链接和细胞分裂识别；
4. 实现一个后处理步骤，利用未被跟踪选中但置信较高的检测点，根据时间和空间连贯性恢复遗漏的轨迹。

lessons.author: Sergio Alvarez
lessons.title: 分开检查目标检测、跨帧关联和轨迹解码
lessons.summary: 冠军沿用先检测后跟踪的思路，但让关联模型同时看到目标附近的图像变化。判断哪里发生了身份交换时，能够回到检测、短时运动线索和相邻帧链接三个阶段逐项排查。
lessons.takeaway: 固定一小段已标注的图像序列，分别统计漏检和错误关联，再决定先改哪一段。

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 作者用 U-Net 预测前景概率和朝向中心的位移场，从三维图像得到候选目标。
steps.bodyEN: A U-Net predicts foreground probability and a field pointing toward centers to generate candidate detections from each volume.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: 局部模型读取同一候选附近连续三帧的裁剪图像，估计状态以及前后位置，为跨帧关联提供外观线索。
steps.bodyEN: A local model takes crops from three neighboring frames and estimates state and positions across time, supplying visual cues for association.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 学习式关联器在相邻两帧间判断哪些候选应当连接，也处理一对多的分支，之后将这些决策组织成轨迹。
steps.bodyEN: A learned linker selects correspondences between adjacent frames, including branching associations. These decisions are then decoded into tracks.

lessons.titleEN: Separate detection, frame linking and track decoding
lessons.summaryEN: The winner used tracking by detection and added learned visual cues around each candidate. An identity switch can be traced back through detection, short-term appearance and motion cues, and links between consecutive frames.
lessons.takeawayEN: Hold out a short annotated sequence and separate missed detections from incorrect links before choosing a stage to change.

exercise.zh: 在连续三帧上给同一目标画出编号，先用真实位置检查匹配，再换回预测位置。如果关联错误随检测替换才出现，应先检查检测误差传播；如果真实位置上也错，则重点检查跨帧匹配。
exercise.en: Mark the same object across three frames. Test links using reference positions, then substitute predicted detections. Errors introduced only by this substitution point toward detection error propagation. Errors present in both runs point toward the linker.

lessons.author: Team Alicia
lessons.title: 第二名方案解析
lessons.summary: 本方案针对预测电动车购买倾向的二分类任务，面对庞大的数据规模和潜在的生成器数据特性，设计了严格的验证机制和多层堆叠模型。采用TabPFN-3.5模型在完整上下文中训练，结合基于生成器的无标签似然比特征（LLR）和多模型堆叠，最后通过精确计算的AUC直接优化目标融合多个模型预测结果。作者着重强调了验证优先、避免过拟合公共排行榜的策略，并利用生成模型的概率特性提取辅助特征，取得了私有排行榜第二名的成绩。
lessons.takeaway: 1. 严格的嵌套交叉验证和公私分数差异分析是防止过拟合公榜的关键。2. 利用生成数据的潜在采样机制构造无标签的LLR特征，有助于提升模型性能。3. TabPFN-3.5能通过完整上下文训练显著提高AUC，且模型性能与上下文大小呈线性提升关系。4. 直接以近似全局AUC为目标的线性组合优化，有效提升最终预测性能。

steps.title: 任务及数据概述
steps.body: 任务是基于表格的13个特征（7数值，6类别），预测电动车购买倾向的二分类问题。训练集包含668,665行数据，测试集286,571行，且数据由合成生成器产生，存在内在的生成器特征，导致公私榜分数差异明显。数据中正例比例17.46%，无训练测试分布漂移，且竞赛提供了原始小规模真实数据集用于分析生成规则。
steps.bodyEN: The task is a tabular binary classification to predict electric vehicle purchase intent using 13 features (7 numeric, 6 categorical). The training set has 668,665 rows, test set 286,571 rows. The data is synthesized from a generator, leading to intrinsic generator features and notable public-private leaderboard score gaps. The positive rate is 17.46%, no train-test distribution shift, and original smaller real data (10k rows) is provided for inspecting the generating formula.

steps.title: 验证策略与数据分割
steps.body: 采用5折嵌套交叉验证，严格定义"诚实"的验证规则，不直接利用公共排行榜作为选择标准。使用固定折拆分，并留出133,733行为封存持出集只在最终训练时纳入。预注册候选模型和结果，所有模型必须通过严格的增益门槛才能进入最终验证。通过对比公私分表现，发现公榜相关度不及嵌套交叉验证的分数，避免了过拟合公榜。
steps.bodyEN: Utilized 5-fold nested cross-validation with strict 'honest' validation policies, avoiding use of public leaderboard for model selection. Fixed folds used, with 133,733 rows sealed holdout set only used in final refit. Candidates and their results were pre-registered; models had to meet strict gain thresholds for advancement. Comparison shows private and nested validation scores highly correlated but public scores less so, preventing leaderboard overfitting.

steps.title: 基于生成器的无标签似然比特征构造
steps.titleEN: Generator Surrogate Label-Free LLR Feature Construction
steps.body: 假设训练数据来自语言模型微调生成的样本，作者使用distilgpt2微调仅使用原始10,000行训练样本（不含竞赛标签），通过计算“Will_Buy_EV是Yes”与“No”条件下样本的生成对数似然之差，生成标注无关的似然比特征（LLR）。LLR在单模型和堆叠中均显著提升性能，成为重要辅助特征。采用多种微调方案平均进一步增加效果，且作为输入特征融入带来的收益大于直接拼接作为普通特征。
steps.bodyEN: Assuming data comes from a fine-tuned LM generator, the authors fine-tuned distilgpt2 only on the original 10k rows without competition labels. They computed the log-likelihood ratio (LLR) of a row under conditions “Will_Buy_EV=Yes” vs “No” across 4 random column orderings. This label-free surrogate LLR feature significantly improved single and stacked models, serving as important auxiliary inputs. Averaging multiple fine-tuned variants further increased gain. Feeding LLR as input rather than raw column yielded better results.

steps.title: TabPFN-3.5大上下文训练及效益
steps.titleEN: TabPFN-3.5 Training with Full Context and Benefits
steps.body: 使用TabPFN-3.5模型，针对每折在剩余约428,000条完整上下文中训练，测试阶段使用全部668,665行数据。该方法在不做上下文子采样的情况下，随着上下文量翻倍AUC持续以约+18.6u的幅度线性提升，未见饱和值。基于此，该技术实现了高效且优异的单模型性能，并对最终堆叠贡献显著。上下文大小对性能贡献远大于模型推理相关超参数调整。
steps.bodyEN: The TabPFN-3.5 model was trained for each fold on the full remaining ~428k context rows, and during test on all 668,665 labeled rows. Without any context subsampling, AUC rose approximately +18.6 units per doubling of context size, showing no saturation. This led to highly effective single-model performance and significant boosting effect in stacking. Context size impact outweighed inference parameter tuning.

steps.title: 基于近似全对偶AUC的层级融合优化
steps.titleEN: Level-3 Blend Optimization via Smoothed Pairwise AUC
steps.body: 最终层融合采用非负权重、权重和为1的线性组合，直接最小化由logit排名分组成的平滑近似全对偶AUC损失。正负样本对数量巨大（约2.6e10），计算用FFT和插值直方图实现高效准确求解。该方法较基于对数损失的融合提升+1.62u，并得到严格嵌套验证通过，且提升主要源自减少AUC优化目标的偏差，说明直接优化对应指标比间接优化更有效。
steps.bodyEN: The level-3 ensemble used a non-negative linear weight combination summing to 1, minimizing a smoothed pairwise AUC loss defined on rank-logits. The extremely large number of positive-negative pairs (~2.6e10) is handled exactly via FFT convolution and linear interpolation histograms. This achieved +1.62u gain over the log-loss based stacking, passed strict nested cross-validation. Results show direct AUC objective optimization reduces metric bias better than indirect log-loss approaches.

llmReview.reason: 该方案给出了可复现的建模、验证与优化细节：预注册的嵌套交叉验证与门控协议、TabPFN全上下文使用及上下文规模规律、GReaT式LLR替代特征构造，以及用直方图+FFT精确计算成对AUC目标的第三层混合代码，均包含可检验的方法与代码，远超结果公告。

lessons.titleEN: 2nd Place Solution Analysis
lessons.summaryEN: This solution addresses the binary classification task of predicting electric vehicle purchase intent, handling large-scale data and features generated by a synthetic data generator. A strict validation regimen and multi-level model stacking are used. TabPFN-3.5 is trained with the full context, combined with generator-based label-free log-likelihood ratio (LLR) features, and multiple models are stacked and blended via an exact AUC-optimized objective. Emphasizing validation-first and avoiding public leaderboard overfitting, the method leverages generator probability approximations for auxiliary features, resulting in a second-place finish on the private leaderboard.
lessons.takeawayEN: 1. Strict nested cross-validation and careful analysis of public-private leaderboard score discrepancies are essential to avoid overfitting public leaderboard. 2. Leveraging generator-based label-free LLR features improves model performance. 3. Training TabPFN-3.5 with full context substantially boosts AUC, showing a log-linear relationship with context size. 4. Directly optimizing a smoothed global AUC objective for ensemble weights effectively enhances the final predictions.

exercise.zh: 尝试使用TabPFN模型，基于完整上下文数据进行训练，并观察不同上下文规模对AUC的影响。然后使用distilgpt2微调生成LLR特征，作为模型额外输入，比较有无LLR时模型性能的区别。最后，设计一个包含非负权重和权重和约束的线性融合，使用FFT高效计算平滑AUC损失进行权重优化，完成模型融合。
exercise.en: Try training TabPFN models using full context data and observe how different context sizes affect AUC. Then fine-tune distilgpt2 to generate LLR features as auxiliary inputs, comparing model performance with and without LLR. Finally, implement a linear blend with non-negative weights summing to one, optimizing weights using FFT-based efficient computation of smoothed AUC loss for ensemble combination.

lessons.originalTitle: 3rd Place Solution — Feature Engineering and Logistic Regression Stacking
lessons.author: M & M
lessons.title: 3rd Place Solution — Feature Engineering and Logistic Regression Stacking
lessons.summary: 获奖队伍已公开赛后复盘，最终名次已与队伍记录核对。
lessons.takeaway: 先阅读作者的验证设计与模型选择，再对照最终成绩。

llmReview.reason: 该文可追溯地记录了多层可复用方法：对精确值与多级取整收入做折外目标编码、用GLM logit作为offset由LightGBM学习残差的堆叠结构、将概率裁剪转logit后做L2逻辑回归堆叠，以及软伪标签和BPE收入token分组特征；还给出相同5折划分、逐步CV对比和验证局限，属于可检查的建模与验证决策，而非仅公布名次。

lessons.author: Chris Deotte
lessons.title: 把六十个表格模型的预测合成一份购买排序
lessons.summary: 冠军在多轮实验中保留可复用的代码与笔记，最终用逻辑回归融合 60 个模型的预测。这里最值得复现的是怎样比较新增模型带来的排序变化，以及怎样区分本地、公开榜和最终榜。
lessons.takeaway: 先拿两组折外预测训练融合器，用独立留出样本检查比最佳单模多排对了哪些样本对。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: AUC 衡量真实购买者排在非购买者前面的概率。作者用本地验证与两种榜单分数记录实验进展。
steps.bodyEN: AUC measures the chance that a buyer ranks ahead of a non-buyer. The team recorded validation, public and private scores for successive stages.

steps.title: 复现与核查
steps.body: 团队在不同阶段交接代码、计划和实验记录，使后续阶段有基线和以往结果可比。
steps.bodyEN: Code, plans and experiment notes were passed between stages, preserving baselines and previous results for comparison.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 最终 60 个模型包括 XGBoost、神经网络和线性模型。各模型预测先转为 logit，再由逻辑回归估计融合权重。
steps.bodyEN: The final pool included XGBoost, neural networks and linear models. Predictions from 60 models were converted to logits and combined with logistic regression.

lessons.titleEN: Combine sixty tabular models into one purchase ranking
lessons.summaryEN: The winners carried code and experiment notes across successive rounds of modeling. Their final stack used logistic regression on predictions from 60 models. The writeup reports local, public and private scores, allowing readers to compare progress across all three.
lessons.takeawayEN: Fit a two-model stack from out-of-fold predictions, then inspect the extra positive–negative pairs it orders correctly on a held-out set.

exercise.zh: 给每一版模型保存折号、折外概率和测试概率。先尝试等权平均，再把概率变成 logit 训练逻辑回归。用未参与调权的样本评价两种融合，检查提升是否主要来自某一类客户。
exercise.en: Save fold IDs, out-of-fold probabilities and test probabilities for each model. Start with an equal-weight blend, then train logistic regression on logits. Evaluate both on rows untouched by weight selection and check whether improvements concentrate in one customer group.

lessons.title: 让六个写作维度各自选模型
lessons.author: AutoX & Rohit & Yevhenii
lessons.summary: 冠军先训练多种文本编码器并保留折外预测，再为六个评分维度分别学习融合权重。
lessons.takeaway: 保留每个模型的折外预测，比较统一权重和每个目标单独调权的误差。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 作者报告融合后的本地验证与榜单变化方向接近；调权使用折外预测，能减轻在训练样本上选权重的偏差。
steps.bodyEN: The authors report that local and leaderboard changes tracked one another. Learning weights on out-of-fold predictions reduces the bias of selecting weights on fitted examples.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: 团队改变文本池化、输入长度和编码器，利用伪标签增加训练样本。这些改变提供不同的模型误差。
steps.bodyEN: The team varied pooling, sequence length and encoder architecture and added pseudo-labeled essays. These choices created models with different error patterns.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 先按单个维度看误差，随后用 Optuna 为各维度调权。可从公开训练代码和最佳提交版本对照复现。
steps.bodyEN: They inspected errors by dimension and used Optuna to tune weights separately. Public training code and the best submission provide reproduction references.

lessons.titleEN: Learn separate ensemble weights for six writing scores
lessons.summaryEN: The winners trained several text encoders, retained out-of-fold predictions and learned a separate set of ensemble weights for each of the six writing dimensions.
lessons.takeawayEN: Save out-of-fold predictions for each encoder. Compare a shared weight vector with a separate vector per target.

exercise.zh: 做一张表，每行是一篇留出作文，每列是某个模型对某一维度的预测。先给所有模型相同权重，再只改变一个维度的权重。分别记录六列误差，检查某一项的收益是否被另一项的退步抵消。
exercise.en: Build a table with one held-out essay per row and a column for each model–target prediction. Start with equal weights and change the weights for one dimension only. Record all six errors to see whether a gain on one dimension hides a loss elsewhere.

lessons.originalTitle: [3rd place] All Medalists Who BC'd on Our Records MUST Vote!
lessons.author: DSM
lessons.title: 铜牌方案解析：BC 预训练、PPO 自对弈与推理时后处理
lessons.summary: 该方案针对一个双人农场模拟游戏，目标是最大化最终资金以获胜。难点在于奖励稀疏（仅最终胜负）、每步决策多（31个）、市场共享导致策略依赖对手。方法动机：先通过行为克隆（BC）从顶尖队伍回放中学习基础策略，再使用 PPO 自对弈强化，并在推理时加入基于规则的后处理以修复无效动作和利用市场机制。
lessons.takeaway: 在长时程、稀疏奖励的竞争环境中，结合模仿学习与自对弈强化学习，并在推理时谨慎加入仅修复确定无效动作的规则，能显著提升胜率。

steps.title: 数据收集与行为克隆预训练
steps.titleEN: Data Collection and Behavior Cloning Pretraining
steps.body: 作者从顶尖队伍的回放中提取状态-动作对，训练一个 Transformer 策略网络来模仿教师动作。输入包括棋盘、单位、商店等 token，输出每个单位的移动和市场订单。通过加权损失（如对购买土地动作加权）和教师嵌入，模型学会了基础策略，为后续 PPO 提供起点。
steps.bodyEN: Authors extracted state-action pairs from top teams' replays to train a Transformer policy network to imitate teacher moves. Input includes board, units, shops as tokens; output is unit moves and market orders. Using weighted loss (e.g., weight 20 for BUY_LAND) and teacher embeddings, the model learns a base policy, providing a starting point for PPO.

steps.title: PPO 自对弈训练
steps.body: 在 BC 预训练的基础上，使用 PPO 进行自对弈训练。奖励仅为最终胜负（±1），采用非对称批评家（antisymmetric critic）和逐决策裁剪（clip per decision）来稳定训练。通过异步演员-学习器架构和大规模并行，模型在数千代中进化，胜率显著提升。
steps.bodyEN: Building on BC pretraining, PPO is used for self-play training. Reward is only final win/loss (±1), with an antisymmetric critic and per-decision clipping to stabilize training. Using asynchronous actors-learners and large-scale parallelism, the model evolves over thousands of generations, significantly improving win rate.

steps.title: 推理时后处理
steps.body: 在推理阶段，作者加入规则来修复确定无效的动作（如无效的 CARE、谷仓溢出销售等），并加入特定规则（如购买瓜种子）。这些规则不影响模型权重，仅对动作进行后处理，从而将胜率从 74.2% 提升至 87.8%。
steps.bodyEN: At inference, rules are added to fix certainly wasted moves (e.g., ineffective CARE, barn overflow selling) and specific rules (e.g., buying melon seeds). These rules do not affect model weights, only post-process actions, raising win rate from 74.2% to 87.8%.
steps.reference: 7.2 Fixing only moves that certainly have no effect

lessons.author: Team Kangaroo🦘
lessons.title: 把训练报告变成监督信号，在影像中定位异常
lessons.summary: 这是冠军队一位成员的分支。4,407 份训练检查中仅 58 份带完整的 12 项标签，训练端另有文字报告。作者利用这些资料补充软标签与区域框，测试时依靠影像预测。
lessons.takeaway: 在同一组留出检查上比较全图汇聚与区域内汇聚，并按异常类别记录误差。

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 团队从训练报告与图像得到各项异常的概率、感兴趣区域与切片病灶框，把这些监督信号区分开来。
steps.bodyEN: The team derived finding probabilities, regions of interest and per-slice lesion boxes from the available training material and used them as distinct supervision signals.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: ConvNeXt-T 编码每张切片。某项异常的区域框与特征格的重叠度决定初始权重，随后在框内学习注意力。
steps.bodyEN: ConvNeXt-T encodes slices. Overlap with a finding’s region box sets the initial pooling weights, then attention is learned within that box.

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 作者按检查划分五折，单独保留 58 份金标准检查作为参照，并比较不同软标签上的折外 AUC。
steps.bodyEN: The author used five study-level folds, kept the 58 gold-labeled studies separate as a reference and compared out-of-fold AUC against different soft labels.

lessons.titleEN: Convert training reports into supervision for image classification
lessons.summaryEN: This is one branch of the winning team. Only 58 of 4,407 training studies had all 12 labels, while reports were available during training. The author used this extra information to derive soft labels and region boxes for an image-based inference pipeline.
lessons.takeawayEN: Compare global pooling with region-based pooling on the same held-out studies and report error by finding.

exercise.zh: 挑一项异常，在同一份检查上对比区域框轻微偏移前后的预测。对多个序列分别打分再取平均，可检查一个错误区域是否拖累整份检查。文字报告只在训练端可用，本地推理也要遵守相同限制。
exercise.en: For one finding, shift its region box slightly and compare predictions on the same study. Inspect series scores before averaging to see whether one poor region dominates the result. Exclude reports during local inference just as at test time.

lessons.originalTitle: 3rd Place Solution: RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection 2026
lessons.author: DataTech Club
lessons.title: 从报告软标签到2.5D MRI阅读器：RSNA膝部异常检测第三名方案拆解
lessons.summary: 该任务要求基于膝部 MRI 图像预测 12 个异常标签，以 ROC AUC 评估，但 4407 个训练研究中仅有 58 个具有专家裁定标签，其余只有多语言报告。作者的做法是：用 GPT-6 Astra 结合 MRI 与报告为多模态软标签（N 版本），再对 PF OA、Lateral OA、Synovitis 做专科读者修正并用分位数映射保留排序（R 版本）；随后训练 2.5D 阅读器（相邻三层切片堆叠为三通道，BiT/ConvNeXt/DINOv3/CoAtNet 骨干，可选深度注意力与 OA 耦合头），并以固定分组预算的概率融合集成。难点在于图像级评价与报告监督之间的错位、标签噪声以及集成权重容易随实验数量失控。
lessons.takeaway: 监督信号的质量与构造方式可能比模型结构更关键：先用图像+报告生成连续软标签，再按发现分层修正标签并固定分组预算做概率融合；同时注意公开/私有榜三位小数下 0.959 并不能证明 Gold 重训或分组策略有优势。

steps.title: 用图像+报告构造12维连续软标签
steps.titleEN: Construct 12 continuous soft targets from images plus reports
steps.body: 输入是每个研究的 MRI 切片与多语言报告。操作：让 GPT-6 Astra 先看 MRI（PF 专科用同一平面/序列组最多 9 张 384px 采样切片的有序拼图），检查位置、严重度与范围，再与报告核对，输出 12 个连续目标；其他报告阅读器意见仅作佐证而非投票，接受的修改只改相关目标。学生模型在冻结快照上训练，看不到报告或阅读器解释。这样做的动机是报告可能漏报或描述低于竞赛阳性阈值的变化，纯文本标签会把图像级目标带偏。局限：这是模型辅助标注，可能引入系统性偏差，作者也未报告该步骤的独立消融。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are each study's MRI slices and multilingual report. GPT-6 Astra first examines the MRI (for the PF specialist, ordered sheets of up to nine sampled 384-px slices from one plane/sequence group), checks location, severity and extent, then reconciles with the report to assign 12 continuous targets. Other report-reader opinions are supporting evidence, not votes, and accepted revisions change only the relevant targets. Student models train on frozen snapshots without reports or reader explanations. The motivation is that reports can omit findings or describe changes below the competition's positive threshold, so purely text-derived labels would misdirect an image-level target. Limitation: this is model-assisted annotation that may carry systematic bias, and no isolated ablation of this step is reported.
steps.reference: 1.1 Read the images, not just the diagnostic terms

steps.title: 按发现修正标签并用分位数映射保留排序
steps.titleEN: Refine labels per finding and preserve ordering via quantile mapping
steps.body: 输入是 N 版本目标与专科读者的修正结果。操作：接受 Lateral OA 与 Synovitis 的专科排序后得到 R 版本；在每个被接受的修正子集内，用新排序选取旧目标的分位数，未修正条目保持不变。动机是新读者可能同时改变排序与概率尺度，分位数映射把两者分开，从而在保留新排序的同时限制尺度漂移。作者明确 R 是目标变换而非 ranking loss，且该映射只用于修正子集内部，不用于测试集预测。局限：它依赖读者对子集的排序质量，且 N 与 R 两版都进入模型池，混合效果未做单因素隔离。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are the N targets and specialist revisions. After accepting specialist rankings for Lateral OA and Synovitis, version R is produced: within each accepted revision subset, ranks select quantiles of the previous targets while unrevised entries stay fixed. The motivation is that a new reader can change both ordering and probability scale; quantile mapping separates these effects, preserving the new ordering while limiting scale changes. The authors state R is a target transformation, not a ranking loss, and the mapping applies only inside revision subsets, not to test-set predictions. Limitation: it depends on the quality of the specialist ordering, and since both N and R enter the pool, their mixing is not isolated as a single-factor ablation.

steps.title: 把膝部MRI读成2.5D窗口并聚合为研究级logits
steps.titleEN: Read knee MRI as 2.5D windows and aggregate to study-level logits
steps.body: 输入是五类采集组（矢状/冠状的流体敏感与非流体敏感、轴位）的切片。操作：按 DICOM 物理几何排序、标准化膝朝向、对缺失视图做掩码；约 140mm 视野缩放到 224/384/512px；每个 2.5D 窗口堆叠同一序列的三张相邻切片作为三通道输入，由 BiT ResNetV2-50、ConvNeXt-Small、DINOv3 ViT-B/16 或 CoAtNet 编码，再经类特定空间池化、全局平均池化与注意力 MIL 聚合成 12 个研究级 logits；代表性缓存按组分配 18/14/12/8/12 个中心位置共至多 64 个，缺失位置掩码。动机是在有限显存下同时利用层内局部结构与跨层上下文。局限：推理只覆盖缓存中的有效窗口，而非全部原始 DICOM 切片。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are slices from five acquisition groups (sagittal/coronal fluid-sensitive and non-fluid-sensitive, and axial). Slices are sorted by DICOM physical geometry, knee orientation is standardized and missing views masked; a roughly 140 mm field of view is resized to 224/384/512 px. Each 2.5D window stacks three adjacent slices from one series as a three-channel input, encoded by BiT ResNetV2-50, ConvNeXt-Small, DINOv3 ViT-B/16 or CoAtNet, then aggregated into 12 study logits by class-specific spatial pooling, global average pooling and attention MIL. A representative cache allocates 18/14/12/8/12 center positions per group, up to 64, with missing positions masked. The motivation is to exploit both in-slice local structure and cross-slice context under limited memory. Limitation: inference covers valid cached windows, not every raw DICOM slice.

steps.title: 可选深度注意力与OA耦合头
steps.titleEN: Optional depth attention and OA-coupled head
steps.body: 输入是同一序列内的窗口特征。操作：深度上下文（36 个成员中的 31 个）在序列内用 32 维投影、2×2 区域池化与 4 个注意力头交换特征，训练包保留序列块并以 32 个窗口为上限；OA 耦合（36 个中的 5 个）学习区域软骨等级，把累积序数预测转为分室最大值加学习残差，只修改三个 OA logits，其余九个不变，OAI 等级仅用于训练监督而耦合预测头在测试时仍生效。动机是让网络利用层间物理位置信息并对 OA 相关的三个发现建模序数结构。局限：这些是作者的配置选择，作者未将其作为单独消融报告收益，且“特征路径为示意而非实测注意力图”。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are window features within a series. Depth context (31 of 36 members) exchanges features using 32-dimensional projections, 2x2 regional pooling and four attention heads within each series, with training bags preserving series blocks capped at 32 windows. OA coupling (5 of 36) learns regional cartilage grades, converting cumulative ordinal predictions into compartment-wise maxima plus learned residuals that modify only the three OA logits while the other nine stay unchanged; OAI grades supervise training only and the coupled head remains active at test time. The motivation is to use physical position between slices and to model ordinal structure for the three OA-related findings. Limitation: these are the authors' configuration choices, not isolated ablations, and figure features are 'schematic, not measured attention maps'.

steps.title: 固定分组预算的概率融合与Gold58重训
steps.titleEN: Group-budget probability fusion and Gold58 refits
steps.body: 输入是各成员对 12 个发现的 sigmoid 概率。操作：基础预测 B[c] = 0.5·mean(Mature12) + 0.5·mean(Matrix20)，其余九个发现用 B[c]；三个弱发现用 P[c] = 0.5·B[c] + 0.5·mean(Expert8)；四个共享 checkpoint 只推理一次但保留两组贡献，得 12+20+8−4=36 个唯一模型，八个专家成员合计获得弱发现 58.33% 的展开权重；随后在冻结 G36 后将可匹配成员替换为含 58 个专家标签研究的重训版本（27 个重训+9 个原 checkpoint），分组与融合不变。动机是防止某架构的实验数或种子数自动决定其权重，并给弱发现额外专家支持。局限：作者自己指出 0.959 的三位小数既未确立 Gold 重训收益也未确立分组优势，且未用重训后的样本内分数重选成员；本方案是可复现的集成工程，而非单因素消融证据。
steps.bodyEN: Inputs are each member's sigmoid probabilities for 12 findings. The base prediction is B[c] = 0.5·mean(Mature12) + 0.5·mean(Matrix20), used for the other nine findings; the weak three use P[c] = 0.5·B[c] + 0.5·mean(Expert8). Four shared checkpoints are inferred once but keep contributions in both groups, giving 12+20+8-4 = 36 unique models, with the eight expert members receiving 58.33% of expanded weak-finding weight. After freezing G36, eligible members are replaced by refits including the 58 expert-labeled studies (27 refits + 9 original checkpoints) with grouping and fusion fixed. The motivation is to stop the number of experiments or seeds for one architecture from determining its share, and to give weak findings extra expert support. Limitation: the authors note the three-decimal 0.959 establishes neither a Gold-refit benefit nor a grouping advantage, and post-refit in-sample scores were not used to reselect members; this is reproducible ensemble engineering, not single-factor ablation evidence.
steps.reference: 4. G36-Gold: fixed group budgets, finding-specific support

llmReview.reason: 该方案详细披露了可复用的建模与集成方法：多模态软标签构建、2.5D 多切片读取器、深度注意力、OAI 外部监督混合、组感知概率融合公式及固定 epoch 训练配方，并附完整训练/推理代码与权重链接，读者可追踪其建模与优化决策。

lessons.titleEN: From Report-Derived Soft Labels to 2.5D MRI Readers: Dissecting the 3rd-Place RSNA Knee Abnormality Solution
lessons.summaryEN: The task is to predict 12 knee abnormality labels from MRI with ROC AUC, yet only 58 of 4,407 training studies had expert-adjudicated labels while the rest only had multilingual reports. The authors built multimodal soft labels (version N) by having GPT-6 Astra review MRI together with the report, then had finding-specific readers refine PF OA, Lateral OA and Synovitis and applied quantile mapping within accepted revisions to preserve ordering (version R). They trained 2.5D readers (three adjacent slices stacked as channels, BiT/ConvNeXt/DINOv3/CoAtNet backbones, optional depth attention and OA-coupled head) and ensembled them with fixed group budgets. The core difficulties are the mismatch between image-level evaluation and report-derived supervision, label noise, and ensemble weights drifting with the number of experiments.
lessons.takeawayEN: Supervision quality and construction may matter more than architecture: generate continuous soft labels from image plus report, refine them per finding, and blend probabilities under fixed group budgets. Also note that at three-decimal leaderboard precision, 0.959 does not prove a benefit from Gold58 refits or the grouping strategy.

exercise.zh: 在公开 Notebook 基础上做小规模对照：固定同一骨干与同一个 seed，仅改变监督构造，比较 (a) 仅用报告文本标签、(b) 图像+报告软标签 N、(c) 对单一发现应用分位数映射的 R 三种设置下的局部 AUC，并记录每种设置下有多少样本被修正；借此检验软标签与分位数映射是否真的带来提升，而不是直接照搬融合权重。
exercise.en: On top of the public notebook, run a small controlled comparison: fix the same backbone and seed and vary only supervision construction, comparing the local AUC of (a) report-text-only labels, (b) image+report soft targets (N), and (c) R with quantile mapping for a single finding, while logging how many samples were revised in each setting. This tests whether soft labels and quantile mapping actually help instead of copying the ensemble weights.

lessons.originalTitle: 1st Place Solution - Our Journey to Becoming Professional Farmers
lessons.author: M & M & P & Q
lessons.title: 让农场智能体先模仿，再用自博弈修正策略
lessons.summary: 农场游戏要经过很多回合才知道输赢。冠军先让策略模仿公开回放，给自博弈一个起点；发现某类局面一直处理不好时，再补入针对性示范，恢复 PPO 训练。
lessons.takeaway: 找一类反复输掉的局面，分别评估补示范前、模仿后和自博弈后的策略。

steps.title: 数据与特征
steps.body: 模型同时利用双方农场、市场与公开游戏状态，并从公开信息估计对手隐藏库存。
steps.bodyEN: Observations combine both farms, the market and public game state. Hidden opponent inventory is estimated from public information.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: 先用公开策略的示范初始化，再通过自博弈训练。发现策略缺口时用短暂模仿阶段补上行为，之后继续优化胜负回报。
steps.bodyEN: The team initialized from demonstrations, moved to PPO self-play, and inserted short imitation phases when the current policy lacked a useful strategy.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 最终方案用规则处理库存和动作冲突。一个提交在推理时修正，另一个还在训练回合中纳入这些规则，使训练时看到的动作更接近部署。
steps.bodyEN: Final agents corrected inventory and conflicting actions. One applied corrections at inference. Another also included them during training rollouts to better match deployment.

lessons.titleEN: Teach a farming policy by imitation, then refine it in self-play
lessons.summaryEN: Games have long horizons and delayed outcomes. The winners initialized a policy from public replays, then trained it in self-play. When replay analysis revealed a missing behavior, they introduced targeted demonstrations and resumed PPO.
lessons.takeawayEN: Choose a recurring losing situation and evaluate the policy before demonstrations, after imitation and after resumed self-play.

exercise.zh: 固定对手与开局，把目标策略出现的次数和整局胜率分开记录。模仿后目标动作更常见，可能只是学会了照做；若下一轮自博弈后同一对手上的胜率也上升，才有依据继续研究它在决策链中的价值。
exercise.en: Fix opponents and starting positions. Count the targeted behavior separately from game wins. Imitation can increase the frequency of an action without improving play. Evaluate it again after self-play to see whether the agent has learned when to use it.
