lessons.originalTitle: 1st Place - TFMs and LLMs with tabular data!
lessons.author: Chris Deotte
lessons.title: 把一行表格当作文本，从两个候选标签反推满意度
lessons.summary: 冠军把每个字段写成可读文本，分别假设旅客满意和不满意，让语言模型评估哪种假设更能解释这一行特征。这种打分方式与已有表格模型犯的错不同，因此还被加入最终融合。
lessons.takeaway: 在一小批留出行上固定字段顺序，对比标签放在开头和末尾的 AUC 与推理开销。

steps.title: 特征表示
steps.body: 每一列写成“列名 is 取值”，按顺序拼成句子。原文用 GPT-2，因而无需为每个字段单设编码器。
steps.bodyEN: Each field becomes “column is value” and the fields form one sequence. The writeup uses GPT-2 without a separate tokenizer for each feature.
steps.reference: How to make two new kinds of tabular LLMs

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.titleEN: Two ways to score a row
steps.body: 标签在末尾时模型根据特征预测标签；放在开头时，分别给定两个标签，比较产生已观测字段的可能性。后者需要多次前向计算。
steps.bodyEN: With a target-last sequence the model predicts the label from the features. With a target-first sequence it scores the observed features under each possible label, requiring additional forward passes.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 作者在含 245 对公开折外与测试预测的堆叠模型上加入自己的分类器，用本地和公开榜分数比较加入前后的表现。
steps.bodyEN: The team added its classifiers to a stack using 245 public pairs of out-of-fold and test predictions and compared validation and public leaderboard scores.
steps.reference: Adding the GPT classifier to the stack

lessons.titleEN: Read a table row under two candidate labels
lessons.summaryEN: The winners serialized each row as text and scored it twice, assuming either a satisfied or dissatisfied passenger. The model that better explains the observed features receives more support. Its predictions added diversity to an existing blend.
lessons.takeawayEN: On held-out rows, fix the feature order and compare AUC and inference cost for target-first and target-last scoring.

exercise.zh: 同一行先写“满意”，再写“不满意”，只改变这一个前缀，记录两种条件下后续字段的对数似然。对差值很小的行，调换字段顺序再测一次。单独记录模型得分和加入融合后的变化，可以看出它贡献的是独立强度还是互补性。
exercise.en: Score the same row twice, changing only the candidate label prefix. Record the log likelihood of the remaining features under both labels. For near ties, change the feature order and rerun. Report standalone performance separately from the gain when adding it to a blend.

lessons.title: 用历史观测和自博弈比较策略版本
lessons.summary: 冠军用历史观测维护地图状态，再用多智能体强化学习训练决策策略。通过与旧版本对战检查新策略是否进步。
lessons.takeaway: 留下一组固定对手和游戏种子，再比较新旧策略的胜率。
lessons.author: Flat Neurons

steps.title: 数据与特征
steps.body: 地图特征包含距离上次观测某格子经过的步数，用于表示部分可观测环境中的历史信息。
steps.bodyEN: Map features include the number of steps since a tile was last observed, representing the age of information under partial observability.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 队伍以 IMPALA 和 V-trace 训练多智能体策略，并调整奖励尺度和熵。
steps.bodyEN: The team trained multi-agent policies with IMPALA and V-trace and adjusted reward scale and entropy.

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 通过大量自博弈及对旧版本、教师版本的胜率比较，评估策略迭代。
steps.bodyEN: They evaluated policy updates through extensive self-play and win-rate comparisons against old and teacher versions.

lessons.titleEN: Use observation history and self-play to compare policies
lessons.summaryEN: The winners maintained map state from previous observations, then trained a multi-agent policy. They checked progress by playing new policies against earlier versions.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keep a fixed set of opponents and game seeds and compare win rates for old and new policies.

exercise.zh: 在回放中挑一个刚离开视野的格子，标记智能体最后观测它的时间。比较有无历史特征时下一步动作是否变化，再用多组固定对手验证。单局获胜只能作案例，胜率比较还要看对局数量和先后手。
exercise.en: Pick a tile that just left view and mark when the policy last observed it. Compare its next action with and without the history feature, then test against several fixed opponents. Treat one win as an example and report the game count and starting side with win rates.

lessons.title: 用多视角一致性修正图像匹配
lessons.author: ZJU3DV
lessons.summary: 一对照片中可信的匹配点，放到多个视角里可能互相矛盾。冠军融合稀疏与稠密匹配，先建粗模型，再迭代细化几何关系。
lessons.takeaway: 先在一个小场景跑通粗重建，再单独打开迭代细化，对比恢复的相机和位姿误差。

steps.title: 数据构造
steps.body: 先挑选有重叠的图像对，检测旋转与重叠区域，减少明显无意义的匹配。
steps.bodyEN: They selected overlapping image pairs and identified rotation and overlap to avoid uninformative matching work.

steps.title: 匹配与重建
steps.body: 稀疏与稠密方法产生互补候选。团队在粗 SfM 前按置信度合并候选，处理同一点在多张图中的不一致。
steps.bodyEN: Sparse and dense matchers proposed complementary points. Before coarse SfM the team merged proposals by confidence to reconcile inconsistent correspondences across images.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 以粗相机和已匹配点为起点迭代细化。逐步记录各场景的重建结果，区分匹配不足和几何优化错误。
steps.bodyEN: Starting from coarse cameras and matched points, they refined iteratively. Track reconstruction results per scene to separate insufficient matches from geometry errors.

lessons.titleEN: Resolve conflicting image matches across views
lessons.summaryEN: A plausible match between two photos may conflict with evidence from other views. The winners combined sparse and dense matches, built a coarse reconstruction and refined the geometry iteratively.
lessons.takeawayEN: Run a coarse reconstruction on one small scene, then switch on refinement alone and compare recovered cameras and pose error.

exercise.zh: 选三张有重叠的照片，在第一张标出一个点，沿两条路径找到它在第三张中的位置。若两条路径不一致，回查遮挡、重复纹理和匹配置信度。记录细化前后可恢复的相机数以及误差，避免只看成功场景。
exercise.en: Mark one point in the first of three overlapping photos and trace it to the third via two paths. If the paths disagree, inspect occlusion, repeated texture and confidence. Record recovered cameras and errors before and after refinement, including failed scenes.

lessons.title: 在几何排布中兼顾可行性与种群多样性
lessons.summary: 冠军方案以遗传算法探索布局，用局部优化减少图块重叠与越界。选择阶段同时考虑代价和布局差异。
lessons.takeaway: 对小规模布局固定边界和随机种子，分别记录可行率、重叠代价与最终边长。
lessons.author: Jeroen Cottaar

steps.title: 模型与优化
steps.body: 通过单个布局的变异及两个布局的交叉产生候选；变异可改变图块的位置和旋转角度。
steps.bodyEN: Mutation changes one layout, including piece positions and rotations. Crossover builds candidates from two layouts.

steps.title: 评估设计
steps.body: 用图块重叠及超出正方形边界的程度构造代价，GPU 局部优化尝试把候选修正为可行解。
steps.bodyEN: A cost measures overlap and protrusion beyond the square. GPU local optimization attempts to repair candidates into feasible layouts.

steps.title: 候选筛选与复现
steps.body: 在每个子种群中保留代价低的部分布局，再结合差异性挑选其余候选。
steps.bodyEN: Each subpopulation keeps some low-cost layouts and uses dissimilarity when selecting the rest.

lessons.titleEN: Balance feasibility and population diversity in packing
lessons.summaryEN: The winning genetic search explores layouts and uses local optimization to reduce overlaps and boundary violations. Selection considers both cost and differences between layouts.
lessons.takeawayEN: On a small instance, fix the boundary and random seed. Record feasibility, overlap cost and final side length separately.

exercise.zh: 在相同边长下从两种布局开始：一种紧凑但略有重叠，另一种留有空隙。给它们相同的局部优化预算，记录能否修复。然后比较仅保留低代价候选与保留不同布局的搜索，观察是否反复卡在同一位置。
exercise.en: At the same side length, start from a tight layout with slight overlap and a looser layout. Give them equal repair budgets. Compare selection by cost alone against keeping dissimilar layouts, and inspect whether the search returns to the same stalled arrangement.

lessons.title: 用整分子上下文预测原子对性质
lessons.summary: 冠军团队将完整分子送入图模型，同时为其中多个原子对预测耦合常数。分层表示将不同粒度的原子和原子对信息组合在一起。
lessons.takeaway: 保留相同数据划分，比较仅使用原子对特征与加入整分子上下文后的误差。
lessons.author: hybrid

steps.title: 特征表示
steps.body: 作者为原子及原子对构建不同细粒度的嵌入，例如在原子类型之外加入连接关系信息。
steps.bodyEN: The authors built embeddings at several resolutions for atoms and pairs, adding connectivity information beyond atom type.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 图 Transformer 风格的模型一次处理整个分子，同时输出多个耦合值。
steps.bodyEN: A graph Transformer-style architecture processes a whole molecule and emits multiple coupling predictions in one pass.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 队伍训练了多个模型进行融合，公开仓库保留了架构变体，便于追溯最终预测。
steps.bodyEN: The team ensembled several models. Their public repository contains architectural variants that help trace the final prediction.

lessons.titleEN: Use the whole molecule to predict atom-pair properties
lessons.summaryEN: The winners sent a complete molecule through a graph model and predicted several coupling constants together. Hierarchical representations combined information about atoms and their pairs at different levels of detail.
lessons.takeawayEN: On the same split, compare pair-only inputs with inputs that include whole-molecule context.

exercise.zh: 选一个分子中的两个原子对，把每个原子的局部信息与整个分子的连接信息分列。先看只用局部特征时哪组误差最大，再加入全图上下文，在相同耦合类型内比较，以免不同类型的数值尺度掩盖变化。
exercise.en: For two pairs in one molecule, separate local atom descriptors from connectivity across the graph. Identify the larger error with pair-only inputs, then add global context. Compare within coupling type so differences in numeric scale do not obscure the effect.

lessons.title: 把分子结构识别拆成候选生成与重排
lessons.summary: 第三名方案先生成多个可能的结构字符串，再检验它们是否有效，并用多个模型重新评分。可分别检查错误发生在候选生成还是排序环节。
lessons.takeaway: 先统计正确结果是否进入候选集，再评价重排能否把正确候选提到首位。
lessons.author: kyamaro

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 团队观察到测试图中椒盐噪声更多，随后在训练图像中加入相应噪声增强。
steps.bodyEN: The team saw more salt-and-pepper noise in test images and added similar noise to training images.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 用多种图像编码器和文本解码器生成 InChI 候选，通过束搜索扩大候选范围。
steps.bodyEN: Several image encoders and text decoders generated InChI candidates. Beam search expanded the candidate pool.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 先检查候选结构是否合法，再用多个模型对图像与候选的匹配损失评分，据此重排。
steps.bodyEN: Invalid candidates were removed. Several models then scored image–candidate matching losses to rerank the remaining strings.

lessons.titleEN: Separate candidate generation from molecular reranking
lessons.summaryEN: The third-place team proposed multiple structural strings, checked their validity and rescored them with several models. This separates errors in generating a candidate from errors in choosing it.
lessons.takeawayEN: Measure how often the true string reaches the candidate set, then how often reranking moves it to first place.

exercise.zh: 把一批图像分成三组：正确字符串没有进入候选集、进入但未排首位、已经排首位。第一组提示需要检查生成器，第二组适合试重排。报告总体编辑距离时，再分别记录这三组的占比。
exercise.en: Group images by whether the correct string was absent from the pool, present but not first, or already first. The first group points to generation and the second to reranking. Report these proportions alongside aggregate edit distance.

lessons.title: 从匿名数值的出现次数提取信号
lessons.author: Wizardry
lessons.summary: 字段没有业务名称，但数值是否重复仍携带信号。冠军围绕每列取值出现的次数构造特征，再融合树模型和专门设计的神经网络。
lessons.takeaway: 对一列做频次编码，在验证集上与原始数值对照，检验规律能否迁移到你的数据。

steps.title: 数据观察
steps.body: 团队逐列分析只出现一次与重复出现的取值，发现不同样本群体的频次结构不同。
steps.bodyEN: The team inspected unique and repeated values column by column and found different frequency patterns across groups of examples.

steps.title: 模型与训练
steps.body: 原始特征与衍生特征分别进入 LightGBM 和定制网络。原文列出两种模型的单模成绩。
steps.bodyEN: Raw and derived features were used in LightGBM and a custom network. The writeup reports individual scores for both models.

steps.title: 复现边界
steps.body: 部分构造利用该比赛特有的数据生成规律。复现时先列清推理时可见的样本范围，再比较两类模型融合后的误差。
steps.bodyEN: Some features depended on the competition’s data-generation process. Define which rows are visible at inference before comparing ensemble errors.

lessons.titleEN: Extract signal from the frequency of anonymized values
lessons.summaryEN: The anonymous columns still reveal whether a value repeats. The winners engineered per-column frequency features and combined tree models with a custom neural network.
lessons.takeawayEN: Frequency-encode one column and compare it with raw values on a held-out split before generalizing to another dataset.

exercise.zh: 手算一列训练值的频次表，再把验证集中的已见值、未见值分开编码。若把验证集也纳入计数会改变特征，应把两种设置作为独立实验记录。最后比较原始值、仅频次、两者合用。
exercise.en: Compute a count table for one training column and encode seen and unseen validation values separately. If including holdout rows in the counts changes features, log that as a distinct experiment. Compare raw values, counts alone and their combination.

lessons.title: 让声音事件检测器保留更多时频细节
lessons.summary: 这份冠军队员的复盘讲解了融合系统中的一个分支：减小卷积网络首层步幅，保留更细的时间和频率分辨率，再对长录音片段进行多标签训练。
lessons.takeaway: 在相同输入和训练预算下，对照首层步幅与背景噪声增强的效果。
lessons.author: KDL

steps.title: 特征表示
steps.body: 将卷积编码器的首层步幅从 2×2 改为 1×1，使后续特征图保留更多时频位置。
steps.bodyEN: The encoder’s first stride was reduced from 2×2 to 1×1 so later feature maps retained more time–frequency locations.

steps.title: 模型训练
steps.body: 在 15 秒片段上结合次要标签训练，用背景录音和其他噪声进行增强，并根据主要鸟种调整采样与损失权重。
steps.bodyEN: The branch trained on 15-second segments with secondary labels, added background recordings and other noise, and adjusted sampling and loss weights by primary species.

steps.title: 推理与融合
steps.body: 作者保留三个检查点并对模型权重取平均。队伍的最终融合还包括 BirdNET 和其他成员的模型。
steps.bodyEN: The author averaged three checkpoints’ weights. The final team ensemble also included BirdNET and models from other members.

lessons.titleEN: Preserve fine time–frequency detail in a bird-call detector
lessons.summaryEN: This winning-team member explains one branch of the ensemble. A smaller initial stride preserves temporal and frequency resolution, and the branch learns multiple labels from longer audio segments.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keep inputs and training budget fixed while comparing the initial stride and background-noise augmentation.

exercise.zh: 在同一段频谱图上标出一声很短的鸟鸣。比较首层步幅为 1 和 2 时，中间特征图还剩多少时间位置。缩小步幅会增加计算量，因此除验证分数外，还要在相同硬件上记录推理耗时。
exercise.en: Mark a short call on one spectrogram. Compare how many time positions remain in an intermediate feature map with first-layer strides of one and two. Smaller strides cost computation, so record inference time on the same hardware alongside validation quality.

lessons.title: 用场地对称性预测推进距离
lessons.author: The Zoo
lessons.summary: 向球场左侧或右侧跑动可以有相同的推进距离。冠军同时翻转横向坐标及相对特征，并在推理时融合镜像输入的预测。
lessons.takeaway: 先把同一场比赛放进同一折，再测试镜像增强，避免相邻回合泄漏到验证集。

steps.title: 验证设计
steps.body: 按 GameId 做 5 折 GroupKFold，验证时仅评估 2018 赛季样本。作者报告该设置与公开榜相关性较好。
steps.bodyEN: They used five-fold GroupKFold by GameId and evaluated only 2018-season examples during validation. The authors reported good agreement with the public board.

steps.title: 数据处理
steps.body: 同一次跑动包含攻守双方的多名球员。构造相对位置时保持跑动方向一致，让表示可在回合之间比较。
steps.bodyEN: Each rushing play contains several offensive and defensive players. A consistent running direction makes relative positions comparable across plays.

steps.title: 推理与复现
steps.body: 对横坐标方向以外的横场 Y 轴做镜像，并同步变换派生特征。分别预测原始与镜像阵形再融合。
steps.bodyEN: They reflected the sideline-to-sideline Y axis and adjusted derived features consistently. Predictions from the original and mirrored formations were blended.

lessons.titleEN: Exploit field symmetry to predict rushing yards
lessons.summaryEN: Runs on opposite sides of the field can lead to the same gain. The winners reflected lateral coordinates and their derived features, then blended predictions from the original and mirrored formations.
lessons.takeawayEN: Keep each game in one fold before testing mirror augmentation, so neighboring plays do not leak into validation.

exercise.zh: 画出一个回合的持球队员和最近防守者，同时画出镜像。两者的距离应相同，而横向速度符号应相反。先用这些关系检查变换是否一致，再比较原始、仅镜像和两者融合后的累计概率曲线。
exercise.en: Plot the ball carrier and nearest defender before and after reflection. Their distance should stay constant while lateral velocity changes sign. Check these invariants first, then compare cumulative predictions from original, mirrored and blended inputs.

comparisons.text: BirdCLEF 2023 先按时长、上传者和鸟种找出重复录音。2022 冠军队的一个模型则缩小首层步幅，保留更细的时频变化。复现鸟声基线时，可以先清理重复样本，再单独测试频谱分辨率的影响。
comparisons.textEN: BirdCLEF 2023 screened for duplicate recordings by duration, uploader and species. A 2022 branch reduced the first stride to retain finer time–frequency changes. Clean the audio collection first, then test spectrogram resolution in a separate experiment.

comparisons.text: 两届 BirdCLEF 方案在不同阶段合并信息。2023 将注意力预测与时间维度上的最大预测组合，2022 的一个分支先平均三个检查点的权重，再参加队伍融合。可以分别记录两种操作带来的分数变化。
comparisons.textEN: The two BirdCLEF solutions combine information at different stages. The 2023 team combined attention predictions with temporal maxima. A 2022 branch averaged three checkpoints before entering the team ensemble. Measure each operation separately.

comparisons.text: BirdCLEF 2023 用五折分层验证比较模型，2024 则发现某一折特别容易，并用信号强度检查差异。验证鸟声模型时，可以同时记录各折的类别分布、录音能量和单折成绩。
comparisons.textEN: BirdCLEF 2023 compared models on five stratified folds. The 2024 team investigated an unusually easy fold using signal strength. Track class mix, recording energy and scores per fold when validating a bird-call model.

comparisons.text: 两届 BirdCLEF 都训练卷积网络识别鸟声。2022 的一个分支用 15 秒片段和次要鸟种标签训练，2024 把 10 秒片段转成 128 个 Mel 频带。比较窗口长度时，可以固定频谱配置与验证划分。
comparisons.textEN: Both BirdCLEF solutions trained convolutional networks. A 2022 branch used 15-second clips with secondary labels, while the 2024 team converted 10-second clips to 128 Mel bands. Hold the split and spectrogram settings fixed when comparing window lengths.

comparisons.text: BMS 从分子图像生成多个结构字符串，CHAMPS 则把已知分子的原子和连接关系作为输入，同时预测多个原子对的性质。迁移方法前，先确定结构是要预测的目标，还是可以提供给模型的输入。
comparisons.textEN: BMS generates structural strings from images. CHAMPS starts with atoms and their connections and predicts properties of several pairs at once. Before transferring a method, establish whether structure is a prediction target or an input you already have.

comparisons.text: BMS 先排除无效分子结构，再用多个模型给候选排序。CHAMPS 直接融合多个模型预测的连续数值。两者的输出形式不同，可以分别检验候选排序和数值融合的收益。
comparisons.textEN: BMS discards invalid structures and combines model scores to rank candidates. CHAMPS combines continuous numerical predictions. Evaluate candidate ranking and numerical blending against their respective output types.
